name: IwasawaTower.eval₂_mem_ideal
statement:
private theorem eval₂_mem_ideal {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (x : S) (P : R[X]) (I : Ideal S)
    (hterm : ∀ i : ℕ, f (P.coeff i) * x ^ i ∈ I) :
    Polynomial.eval₂ f x P ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.eval₂_eq_sum_range]
  exact I.sum_mem fun i hi ↦ hterm i

name: IwasawaTower.integralTowerElement_eq_F
statement:
theorem integralTowerElement_eq_F :
    integralTowerElement a hζ = F (3 ^ (a + 1)) hζ.toInteger
proof:
:= by
  rw [integralTowerElement, integerReversedPolynomial, Polynomial.eval₂_comp]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval₂_sub, Polynomial.eval₂_one, Polynomial.eval₂_X]
  have hy : (1 : 𝓞) - (1 - hζ.toInteger) = hζ.toInteger := by ring
  rw [hy]
  have hA (r : ℕ) : Polynomial.eval₂ (Int.castRingHom 𝓞) hζ.toInteger
      (APoly r : ℤ[X]) = pochhammer hζ.toInteger r := by
    change (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (Int.castRingHom 𝓞) hζ.toInteger)
      (∏ j ∈ Finset.range r, (1 + X ^ (j + 1))) = _
    rw [map_prod]
    simp [pochhammer]
  have hA2 (r : ℕ) : Polynomial.eval₂ (Int.castRingHom 𝓞) hζ.toInteger
      ((APoly r : ℤ[X]) ^ 2) = pochhammer hζ.toInteger r ^ 2 := by
    rw [Polynomial.eval₂_pow, hA]
  change (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (Int.castRingHom 𝓞) hζ.toInteger)
    (FPoly (3 ^ (a + 1)) : ℤ[X]) = _
  simp [FPoly, F, hA2]

name: IwasawaTower.algebraMap_integralTowerElement_eq_T
statement:
theorem algebraMap_integralTowerElement_eq_T :
    algebraMap 𝓞 K (integralTowerElement a hζ) = T (3 ^ (a + 1)) ζ
proof:
:= by
  rw [integralTowerElement_eq_F]
  have hmap : algebraMap 𝓞 K (F (3 ^ (a + 1)) hζ.toInteger) =
      F (3 ^ (a + 1)) ζ := by
    simp [F, pochhammer, hζ.coe_toInteger]
  rw [hmap, ← T_eq_F]
  · exact Odd.pow (by decide : Odd (3 : ℕ))
  · positivity
  · exact hζ

name: IwasawaTower.cyclotomicPrime_eq_span_one_sub
statement:
private theorem cyclotomicPrime_eq_span_one_sub :
    cyclotomicPrime a hζ = Ideal.span {1 - hζ.toInteger}
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton.mpr
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using
    Associated.neg_right (Associated.refl (hζ.toInteger - 1))

name: IwasawaTower.cyclotomicPrime_isPrime
statement: private theorem cyclotomicPrime_isPrime : (cyclotomicPrime a hζ).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [cyclotomicPrime]
  exact IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.isPrime_span_zeta_sub_one 3 a hζ

name: IwasawaTower.cyclotomicPrime_ne_bot
statement: private theorem cyclotomicPrime_ne_bot : cyclotomicPrime a hζ ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [cyclotomicPrime, ne_eq, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
  exact (hζ.zeta_sub_one_prime.ne_zero)

name: IwasawaTower.ramification_ideal_identity
proof:
:= by
  have h := IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.map_eq_span_zeta_sub_one_pow 3 a hζ
  have hfin : Module.finrank ℚ K = (3 ^ (a + 1)).totient :=
    IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.finrank (3 ^ (a + 1)) K
  rw [hfin, Nat.totient_prime_pow_succ (by decide)] at h
  simpa [cyclotomicPrime, mul_comm] using h

name: IwasawaTower.cyclotomicPrime_liesOver
statement:
private theorem cyclotomicPrime_liesOver :
    (cyclotomicPrime a hζ).LiesOver (Ideal.span {(3 : ℤ)})
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [cyclotomicPrime]
  exact IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.liesOver_span_zeta_sub_one 3 a hζ

name: IwasawaTower.integralTowerElement_exact_membership
statement:
private theorem integralTowerElement_exact_membership :
    let d := 2 * 3 ^ a - 1
    integralTowerElement a hζ ∈ cyclotomicPrime a hζ ^ d ∧
      integralTowerElement a hζ ∉ cyclotomicPrime a hζ ^ (d + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let d := 2 * 3 ^ a - 1
  let e := 2 * 3 ^ a
  let Pz := integerReversedPolynomial (3 ^ (a + 1))
  let y : 𝓞 := 1 - hζ.toInteger
  let P := cyclotomicPrime a hζ
  let c : ℤ := Pz.coeff d
  let R : ℤ[X] := Pz - C c * X ^ d
  have heq : e = d + 1 := by
    have hp : 0 < 3 ^ a := pow_pos (by omega) _
    dsimp [d, e]
    omega
  have hPy : P = Ideal.span {y} := by
    simpa [P, y] using cyclotomicPrime_eq_span_one_sub a hζ
  have hyP : y ∈ P := by rw [hPy]; exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self y
  have hram : Ideal.map (algebraMap ℤ 𝓞) (Ideal.span {(3 : ℤ)}) = P ^ e := by
    simpa [P, e] using ramification_ideal_identity a hζ
  have lowCoeffMem {i m : ℕ} (hi : i < d) (hm : m ≤ e) :
      algebraMap ℤ 𝓞 (Pz.coeff i) * y ^ i ∈ P ^ m := by
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := three_dvd_integerReversedPolynomial_coeff_lt a i (by
      simpa [d, Pz] using hi)
    have hthree : algebraMap ℤ 𝓞 (3 : ℤ) ∈ P ^ e := by
      rw [← hram]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap ℤ 𝓞) (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self (3 : ℤ))
    have hcoeff : algebraMap ℤ 𝓞 (Pz.coeff i) ∈ P ^ e := by
      rw [hz, map_mul]
      exact (P ^ e).mul_mem_right (algebraMap ℤ 𝓞 z) hthree
    exact (P ^ m).mul_mem_right (y ^ i)
      ((Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hm) hcoeff)
  have highCoeffMem {i m : ℕ} (hi : m ≤ i) :
      algebraMap ℤ 𝓞 (Pz.coeff i) * y ^ i ∈ P ^ m := by
    exact (P ^ m).mul_mem_left (algebraMap ℤ 𝓞 (Pz.coeff i))
      ((Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hi) (Ideal.pow_mem_pow hyP i))
  have htotal : Polynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap ℤ 𝓞) y Pz ∈ P ^ d := by
    apply eval₂_mem_ideal
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i < d
    · exact lowCoeffMem hi (by rw [heq]; omega)
    · exact highCoeffMem (Nat.le_of_not_gt hi)
  have hrem : Polynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap ℤ 𝓞) y R ∈ P ^ e := by
    apply eval₂_mem_ideal
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i < d
    · have hid : i ≠ d := by omega
      simpa [R, coeff_sub, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_pow, if_neg hid] using
        (lowCoeffMem hi le_rfl)
    · by_cases hid : i = d
      · subst i
        simp [R, c]
      · have hie : e ≤ i := by rw [heq]; omega
        have hhigh := highCoeffMem (m := e) hie
        simpa [R, coeff_sub, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_pow, if_neg hid] using hhigh
  have hcoeffMod : (c : ZMod 3) = -1 := by
    simpa [c, d, Pz] using integerReversedPolynomial_coeff_lead_mod_three a
  have hcoeffNotMem : algebraMap ℤ 𝓞 c ∉ P := by
    intro hc
    haveI : P.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(3 : ℤ)}) := by
      simpa [P] using cyclotomicPrime_liesOver a hζ
    have hcUnder : c ∈ Ideal.under ℤ P := by
      rw [Ideal.under_def, Ideal.mem_comap]
      exact hc
    have hcThree : c ∈ Ideal.span {(3 : ℤ)} := by
      have hover : Ideal.span {(3 : ℤ)} = Ideal.under ℤ P :=
        (Ideal.liesOver_iff P (Ideal.span {(3 : ℤ)})).mp
          (show P.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(3 : ℤ)}) from inferInstance)
      rw [hover]
      exact hcUnder
    have hdiv : (3 : ℤ) ∣ c := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hcThree
    have hzero : (c : ZMod 3) = 0 :=
      (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd c 3).2 hdiv
    rw [hzero] at hcoeffMod
    norm_num at hcoeffMod
  have hyPrime : Prime y := by
    have hz : Prime (hζ.toInteger - 1) := hζ.zeta_sub_one_prime
    have hy : y = -(hζ.toInteger - 1) := by simp [y]
    rw [hy]
    exact hz.neg
  have hleadNot : algebraMap ℤ 𝓞 c * y ^ d ∉ P ^ e := by
    intro hmem
    have hdiv : y ^ (d + 1) ∣ y ^ d * algebraMap ℤ 𝓞 c := by
      rw [heq] at hmem
      rw [hPy, Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hmem
      simpa [mul_comm] using hmem
    rcases prime_pow_succ_dvd_mul hyPrime hdiv with hpow | hc
    · have := (pow_dvd_pow_iff hyPrime.ne_zero hyPrime.not_unit).mp hpow
      omega
    · exact hcoeffNotMem (by rw [hPy, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]; exact hc)
  have hnot : Polynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap ℤ 𝓞) y Pz ∉ P ^ e := by
    intro hmem
    have hleadMem : algebraMap ℤ 𝓞 c * y ^ d ∈ P ^ e := by
      have hsub := (P ^ e).sub_mem hmem hrem
      have heval : Polynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap ℤ 𝓞) y Pz -
          Polynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap ℤ 𝓞) y R =
          algebraMap ℤ 𝓞 c * y ^ d := by
        dsimp only [R]
        rw [Polynomial.eval₂_sub, Polynomial.eval₂_mul,
          Polynomial.eval₂_C, Polynomial.eval₂_pow, Polynomial.eval₂_X]
        ring
      rwa [heval] at hsub
    exact hleadNot hleadMem
  simpa [integralTowerElement, Pz, y, P, d, heq] using And.intro htotal hnot

name: IwasawaTower.primeIdealOrder_integralTowerElement
statement:
theorem primeIdealOrder_integralTowerElement :
    primeIdealOrder a hζ (integralTowerElement a hζ) = 2 * 3 ^ a - 1
proof:
:= by
  let d := 2 * 3 ^ a - 1
  have hm := integralTowerElement_exact_membership a hζ
  have hdvd : cyclotomicPrime a hζ ^ d ∣
      Ideal.span {integralTowerElement a hζ} :=
    Ideal.dvd_span_singleton.mpr hm.1
  have hnotdvd : ¬cyclotomicPrime a hζ ^ (d + 1) ∣
      Ideal.span {integralTowerElement a hζ} := by
    simpa [Ideal.dvd_span_singleton] using hm.2
  simpa [primeIdealOrder, d] using multiplicity_eq_of_dvd_of_not_dvd hdvd hnotdvd

name: IwasawaTower.intValuation_integralTowerElement
statement:
theorem intValuation_integralTowerElement :
    (cyclotomicPlace a hζ).intValuation (integralTowerElement a hζ) =
      WithZero.exp (-(2 * 3 ^ a - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : integralTowerElement a hζ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hx
    have hm := (integralTowerElement_exact_membership a hζ).2
    exact hm (by simp [hx])
  rw [IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.intValuation_eq_exp_neg_multiplicity _ hx]
  rw [show multiplicity (cyclotomicPlace a hζ).asIdeal
      (Ideal.span {integralTowerElement a hζ}) = 2 * 3 ^ a - 1 by
    simpa [cyclotomicPlace, primeIdealOrder] using
      primeIdealOrder_integralTowerElement a hζ]

name: IwasawaTower.valuation_T
statement:
theorem valuation_T :
    (cyclotomicPlace a hζ).valuation K (T (3 ^ (a + 1)) ζ) =
      WithZero.exp (-(2 * 3 ^ a - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← algebraMap_integralTowerElement_eq_T a hζ,
    IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_of_algebraMap,
    intValuation_integralTowerElement]

name: IwasawaTower.padicValInt_norm_integralTowerElement
statement:
theorem padicValInt_norm_integralTowerElement :
    padicValInt 3 (Algebra.norm ℤ (integralTowerElement a hζ)) =
      2 * 3 ^ a - 1
proof:
:= by
  let d := 2 * 3 ^ a - 1
  let e := 2 * 3 ^ a
  let x := integralTowerElement a hζ
  let P := cyclotomicPrime a hζ
  let I := Ideal.span {x}
  have heq : e = d + 1 := by
    have hp : 0 < 3 ^ a := pow_pos (by omega) _
    dsimp [d, e]
    omega
  have hm := integralTowerElement_exact_membership a hζ
  have hdvd : P ^ d ∣ I := by
    simpa [P, I, x, Ideal.dvd_span_singleton] using hm.1
  have hnotdvd : ¬P ^ (d + 1) ∣ I := by
    simpa [P, I, x, Ideal.dvd_span_singleton] using hm.2
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := hdvd
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hx
    exact hm.2 (by simp [x, hx])
  have hIbot : I ≠ ⊥ := by
    simpa [I, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot] using hx
  have hPnotJ : ¬P ∣ J := by
    intro hPJ
    apply hnotdvd
    rw [hJ, pow_succ]
    exact mul_dvd_mul_left (P ^ d) hPJ
  have hJbot : J ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hbot
    apply hIbot
    rw [hJ, hbot, mul_bot]
  have hPmax : P.IsMaximal :=
    (cyclotomicPrime_isPrime a hζ).isMaximal (cyclotomicPrime_ne_bot a hζ)
  have hthreeNot : ¬3 ∣ Ideal.absNorm J := by
    intro hthree
    obtain ⟨Q, hQmax, hQunder, hQJ⟩ :=
      Ideal.exists_isMaximal_dvd_of_dvd_absNorm' (by decide : Nat.Prime 3) J hthree
    have hmaple : Ideal.map (algebraMap ℤ 𝓞) (Ideal.span {(3 : ℤ)}) ≤ Q := by
      rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, ← Ideal.under_def, hQunder]
      norm_num
    have hQeq : Q = P := by
      have hpowle : P ^ e ≤ Q := by
        rw [← ramification_ideal_identity a hζ]
        exact hmaple
      haveI : Q.IsPrime := hQmax.isPrime
      have hPle : P ≤ Q := Ideal.IsPrime.le_of_pow_le hpowle
      exact (hPmax.eq_of_le hQmax.ne_top hPle).symm
    exact hPnotJ (hQeq ▸ hQJ)
  have hnormJ : Ideal.absNorm J ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [ne_eq, Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff]
  have hnormP : Ideal.absNorm P = 3 := by
    dsimp [P, cyclotomicPrime]
    exact IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.absNorm_span_zeta_sub_one 3 a hζ
  have hnorm : (Algebra.norm ℤ x).natAbs = 3 ^ d * Ideal.absNorm J := by
    rw [← Ideal.absNorm_span_singleton, show Ideal.span {x} = I by rfl,
      hJ, map_mul, map_pow, hnormP]
  rw [padicValInt, hnorm,
    padicValNat.mul (pow_ne_zero d (by decide)) hnormJ,
    padicValNat.prime_pow, padicValNat.eq_zero_of_not_dvd hthreeNot, add_zero]

name: IwasawaTower.norm_T_padic_order
statement:
theorem norm_T_padic_order :
    padicValInt 3 (Algebra.norm ℤ (integralTowerElement a hζ)) =
      2 * 3 ^ a - 1
proof:
:=
  padicValInt_norm_integralTowerElement a hζ

name: IwasawaTower.algebraNorm_T_eq_towerNormInteger
statement:
theorem algebraNorm_T_eq_towerNormInteger :
    Algebra.norm ℚ (T (3 ^ (a + 1)) ζ) =
      algebraMap ℤ ℚ (towerNormInteger a hζ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← algebraMap_integralTowerElement_eq_T a hζ]
  exact (Algebra.coe_norm_int (x := integralTowerElement a hζ)).symm

name: IwasawaTower.v3_towerNormInteger
statement:
theorem v3_towerNormInteger :
    padicValInt 3 (towerNormInteger a hζ) = 2 * 3 ^ a - 1
proof:

  exact padicValInt_norm_integralTowerElement a hζ

name: IwasawaTower.towerExponent_eq_totient_sub_one
statement:
theorem towerExponent_eq_totient_sub_one :
    2 * 3 ^ a - 1 = (3 ^ (a + 1)).totient - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.totient_prime_pow_succ (by decide : Nat.Prime 3)]
  omega

name: IwasawaTower.towerExponent_recurrence
statement:
theorem towerExponent_recurrence :
    2 * 3 ^ (a + 1) - 1 = 3 * (2 * 3 ^ a - 1) + 2
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < 3 ^ a := pow_pos (by omega) _
  rw [pow_succ]
  omega

name: IwasawaTower.iwasawa_tower_law
statement:
theorem iwasawa_tower_law {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    [hK : IsCyclotomicExtension {3 ^ n} ℚ K]
    {ζ : K} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (3 ^ n)) :
    multiplicity (Ideal.span {hζ.toInteger - 1})
      (Ideal.span {positiveLevelIntegral n hζ}) = 2 * 3 ^ (n - 1) - 1
proof:
:= by
  let a := n - 1
  have han : a + 1 = n := by dsimp [a]; omega
  letI hKa : IsCyclotomicExtension {3 ^ (a + 1)} ℚ K := by
    rw [han]
    infer_instance
  have hζa : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (3 ^ (a + 1)) := by simpa [han] using hζ
  simpa [primeIdealOrder, cyclotomicPrime, integralTowerElement,
    positiveLevelIntegral, a, han] using primeIdealOrder_integralTowerElement a hζa

name: IwasawaTower.iwasawa_tower_law_totient
statement:
theorem iwasawa_tower_law_totient {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    [hK : IsCyclotomicExtension {3 ^ n} ℚ K]
    {ζ : K} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (3 ^ n)) :
    multiplicity (Ideal.span {hζ.toInteger - 1})
      (Ideal.span {positiveLevelIntegral n hζ}) = (3 ^ n).totient - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [iwasawa_tower_law hn hζ]
  let a := n - 1
  have han : a + 1 = n := by dsimp [a]; omega
  simpa [han, a] using towerExponent_eq_totient_sub_one a

name: IwasawaTower.iwasawa_tower_valuation
statement:
theorem iwasawa_tower_valuation {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    [hK : IsCyclotomicExtension {3 ^ n} ℚ K]
    {ζ : K} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (3 ^ n)) :
    (positiveLevelPlace n hn hζ).valuation K (T (3 ^ n) ζ) =
      WithZero.exp (-(2 * 3 ^ (n - 1) - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  let a := n - 1
  have han : a + 1 = n := by dsimp [a]; omega
  letI hKa : IsCyclotomicExtension {3 ^ (a + 1)} ℚ K := by
    rw [han]
    infer_instance
  have hζa : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (3 ^ (a + 1)) := by simpa [han] using hζ
  simpa [positiveLevelPlace, a, han] using valuation_T a hζa

name: IwasawaTower.algebraNorm_T_eq_positiveLevelNormInteger
statement:
theorem algebraNorm_T_eq_positiveLevelNormInteger {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    [hK : IsCyclotomicExtension {3 ^ n} ℚ K]
    {ζ : K} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (3 ^ n)) :

    infer_instance
  have hζa : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (3 ^ (a + 1)) := by simpa [han] using hζ
  simpa [positiveLevelNormInteger, positiveLevelIntegral, towerNormInteger,
    integralTowerElement, a, han] using algebraNorm_T_eq_towerNormInteger a hζa

name: IwasawaTower.iwasawa_norm_tower_law
statement:
theorem iwasawa_norm_tower_law {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    [hK : IsCyclotomicExtension {3 ^ n} ℚ K]
    {ζ : K} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (3 ^ n)) :
    padicValInt 3 (positiveLevelNormInteger n hζ) = 2 * 3 ^ (n - 1) - 1
proof:
:= by
  let a := n - 1
  have han : a + 1 = n := by dsimp [a]; omega
  letI hKa : IsCyclotomicExtension {3 ^ (a + 1)} ℚ K := by
    rw [han]
    infer_instance
  have hζa : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (3 ^ (a + 1)) := by simpa [han] using hζ
  simpa [positiveLevelNormInteger, positiveLevelIntegral, towerNormInteger,

name: IwasawaTower.iwasawa_norm_tower_law_totient
statement:
theorem iwasawa_norm_tower_law_totient {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    [hK : IsCyclotomicExtension {3 ^ n} ℚ K]
    {ζ : K} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (3 ^ n)) :
    padicValInt 3 (positiveLevelNormInteger n hζ) = (3 ^ n).totient - 1
proof:

  have han : a + 1 = n := by dsimp [a]; omega

name: IwasawaTower.map_APoly
statement:
private theorem map_APoly (r : ℕ) :
    (APoly r : ℤ[X]).map (Int.castRingHom 𝔽₃) = (APoly r : 𝔽₃[X])
proof:
:= by
  simp only [APoly]
  change (Polynomial.mapRingHom (Int.castRingHom 𝔽₃))
    (∏ j ∈ Finset.range r, (1 + X ^ (j + 1))) = _
  rw [map_prod (Polynomial.mapRingHom (Int.castRingHom 𝔽₃))]
  simp

name: IwasawaTower.map_FPoly
statement:
private theorem map_FPoly (N : ℕ) :
    (FPoly N : ℤ[X]).map (Int.castRingHom 𝔽₃) = (FPoly N : 𝔽₃[X])
proof:
:= by
  simp only [FPoly]
  change (Polynomial.mapRingHom (Int.castRingHom 𝔽₃))
    (∑ r ∈ Finset.range N, X ^ (r + 1) * (APoly r : ℤ[X]) ^ 2) = _
  rw [map_sum (Polynomial.mapRingHom (Int.castRingHom 𝔽₃))]
  simp [map_APoly]

name: IwasawaTower.map_integerReversedPolynomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_integerReversedPolynomial (N : ℕ) :
    (integerReversedPolynomial N).map (Int.castRingHom 𝔽₃) =
      reducedReversedPolynomial N
proof:
:= by
  rw [integerReversedPolynomial, reducedReversedPolynomial, Polynomial.map_comp,
    map_FPoly]
  simp

name: IwasawaTower.coe_reducedReversedPolynomial
statement:
theorem coe_reducedReversedPolynomial (N : ℕ) :
    ((reducedReversedPolynomial N : 𝔽₃[X]) : Series.PS) = Series.F N
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Polynomial.eval₂_C_X_eq_coe, reducedReversedPolynomial,
    Polynomial.eval₂_comp, Polynomial.eval₂_C_X_eq_coe]
  rw [show (((1 - X : 𝔽₃[X]) : Series.PS)) =
    (1 - PowerSeries.X : Series.PS) by simp]
  change Polynomial.eval₂ (PowerSeries.C : 𝔽₃ →+* Series.PS)
    (1 - PowerSeries.X : Series.PS) (FPoly N : 𝔽₃[X]) = Series.F N
  have hA (r : ℕ) : Polynomial.eval₂ (PowerSeries.C : 𝔽₃ →+* Series.PS)
      (1 - PowerSeries.X : Series.PS)
      (APoly r : 𝔽₃[X]) = Series.A r := by
    simp only [APoly, Series.A]
    change (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (PowerSeries.C : 𝔽₃ →+* Series.PS)
      (1 - PowerSeries.X : Series.PS))
      (∏ j ∈ Finset.range r, (1 + X ^ (j + 1))) = _
    rw [map_prod (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (PowerSeries.C : 𝔽₃ →+* Series.PS)
      (1 - PowerSeries.X : Series.PS))]
    simp [Series.X, Series.Y]
  simp only [FPoly, Series.F]
  have hA2 (r : ℕ) : Polynomial.eval₂ (PowerSeries.C : 𝔽₃ →+* Series.PS)
      (1 - PowerSeries.X : Series.PS) ((APoly r : 𝔽₃[X]) ^ 2) =
      Series.A r ^ 2 := by
    change (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (PowerSeries.C : 𝔽₃ →+* Series.PS)
      (1 - PowerSeries.X : Series.PS)) ((APoly r : 𝔽₃[X]) ^ 2) = _
    rw [map_pow]
    change (Polynomial.eval₂ (PowerSeries.C : 𝔽₃ →+* Series.PS)
      (1 - PowerSeries.X : Series.PS) (APoly r : 𝔽₃[X])) ^ 2 = _
    rw [hA]
  change (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (PowerSeries.C : 𝔽₃ →+* Series.PS)
    (1 - PowerSeries.X : Series.PS))
    (∑ r ∈ Finset.range N, X ^ (r + 1) * (APoly r : 𝔽₃[X]) ^ 2) = _
  rw [map_sum (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (PowerSeries.C : 𝔽₃ →+* Series.PS)
    (1 - PowerSeries.X : Series.PS))]
  simp [hA2, Series.X, Series.Y]

name: IwasawaTower.coeff_eq_of_hasLeading
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i hi
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h
    have hc := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff i) hq
    simpa [Series.HasLeading, Series.ModY, Series.Y,
      PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul_X_pow, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow,
      PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul', hi.ne,
      show ¬n + 1 ≤ i by omega] using hc
  · obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h
    have hc := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff n) hq
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    simpa [Series.HasLeading, Series.ModY, Series.Y,
      PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul_X_pow, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul',
      show ¬n + 1 ≤ n by omega] using hc

name: IwasawaTower.reducedReversedPolynomial_coeff_lt
statement:
theorem reducedReversedPolynomial_coeff_lt (a i : ℕ)
    (hi : i < 2 * 3 ^ a - 1) :
    (reducedReversedPolynomial (3 ^ (a + 1))).coeff i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := (coeff_eq_of_hasLeading (Series.F_three_power_hasLeading a)).1 i hi
  simpa [← coe_reducedReversedPolynomial] using h

name: IwasawaTower.reducedReversedPolynomial_coeff_lead

theorem reducedReversedPolynomial_coeff_lead (a : ℕ) :
    (reducedReversedPolynomial (3 ^ (a + 1))).coeff (2 * 3 ^ a - 1) = -1
proof:
:= by
  have h := (coeff_eq_of_hasLeading (Series.F_three_power_hasLeading a)).2
  simpa [← coe_reducedReversedPolynomial] using h

name: IwasawaTower.three_dvd_integerReversedPolynomial_coeff_lt
statement:
theorem three_dvd_integerReversedPolynomial_coeff_lt (a i : ℕ)
    (hi : i < 2 * 3 ^ a - 1) :
    (3 : ℤ) ∣ (integerReversedPolynomial (3 ^ (a + 1))).coeff i
proof:
:= by
  apply (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd
    ((integerReversedPolynomial (3 ^ (a + 1))).coeff i) 3).mp
  calc
    ((integerReversedPolynomial (3 ^ (a + 1))).coeff i : 𝔽₃) =
        ((integerReversedPolynomial (3 ^ (a + 1))).map
          (Int.castRingHom 𝔽₃)).coeff i := by rw [coeff_map]; rfl
    _ = (reducedReversedPolynomial (3 ^ (a + 1))).coeff i := by
      rw [map_integerReversedPolynomial]
    _ = 0 := reducedReversedPolynomial_coeff_lt a i hi

name: IwasawaTower.integerReversedPolynomial_coeff_lead_mod_three
statement:
theorem integerReversedPolynomial_coeff_lead_mod_three (a : ℕ) :
    ((integerReversedPolynomial (3 ^ (a + 1))).coeff (2 * 3 ^ a - 1) : 𝔽₃) = -1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ((integerReversedPolynomial (3 ^ (a + 1))).coeff (2 * 3 ^ a - 1) : 𝔽₃) =
        ((integerReversedPolynomial (3 ^ (a + 1))).map
          (Int.castRingHom 𝔽₃)).coeff (2 * 3 ^ a - 1) := by rw [coeff_map]; rfl
    _ = (reducedReversedPolynomial (3 ^ (a + 1))).coeff (2 * 3 ^ a - 1) := by
      rw [map_integerReversedPolynomial]
    _ = -1 := reducedReversedPolynomial_coeff_lead a

name: IwasawaTower.reducedReversedPolynomial_congruence
statement:
theorem reducedReversedPolynomial_congruence (a : ℕ) :
    ∃ Q : 𝔽₃[X],
      reducedReversedPolynomial (3 ^ (a + 1)) =
        -X ^ (2 * 3 ^ a - 1) + X ^ (2 * 3 ^ a) * Q
proof:
:= by
  let d := 2 * 3 ^ a - 1
  let P := reducedReversedPolynomial (3 ^ (a + 1)) + X ^ d
  have hdiv : X ^ (d + 1) ∣ P := by
    rw [X_pow_dvd_iff]
    intro i hi
    simp only [P, coeff_add, coeff_X_pow]
    by_cases hid : i = d
    · subst i
      rw [if_pos rfl, reducedReversedPolynomial_coeff_lead]
      decide
    · rw [if_neg hid]
      have hid' : i < 2 * 3 ^ a - 1 := by
        dsimp [d] at hi
        omega
      simp [reducedReversedPolynomial_coeff_lt a i hid']
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hdiv
  refine ⟨Q, ?_⟩
  have hp : 0 < 3 ^ a := pow_pos (by omega) _
  rw [show d + 1 = 2 * 3 ^ a by dsimp [d]; omega] at hQ
  dsimp [P] at hQ
  linear_combination hQ

name: IwasawaTower.Series.A_eq_factor_mul_except
statement:
private theorem A_eq_factor_mul_except {r j : ℕ} (hj : j < r) :
    A r = (1 + X ^ (j + 1)) * AExcept r j
proof:
:= by
  rw [A, AExcept]
  exact (Finset.mul_prod_erase (Finset.range r)
    (fun l ↦ 1 + X ^ (l + 1)) (Finset.mem_range.mpr hj)).symm

name: IwasawaTower.Series.cancel_square_divisor
statement:
private theorem cancel_square_divisor (a b c d : PS) (h : d * d⁻¹ = 1) :
    a * (d * b) ^ 2 * (c * d⁻¹) = a * c * d * b ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_two]
  calc
    a * ((d * b) * (d * b)) * (c * d⁻¹) =
        (d * d⁻¹) * (a * c * d * (b * b)) := by ac_rfl
    _ = a * c * d * b ^ 2 := by rw [h, one_mul, pow_two]

name: IwasawaTower.Series.weighted_A_sq_mul_L
statement:
private theorem weighted_A_sq_mul_L (r : ℕ) :
    X ^ (r + 1) * A r ^ 2 * L r =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range r,
        X ^ (r + 1) * X ^ (j + 1) * (1 + X ^ (j + 1)) * AExcept r j ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [L, mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [A_eq_factor_mul_except (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)]
  exact cancel_square_divisor _ _ _ _ (one_add_X_pow_mul_inv (j + 1))

  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r hr
  rw [mul_sub, mul_one, weighted_A_sq_mul_L]

statement:
theorem sub {n : ℕ} {f f' g g' : PS} (hf : ModY n f f') (hg : ModY n g g') :

proof:
:=

name: IwasawaTower.Series.ModY.mul
statement:
theorem mul {n : ℕ} {f f' g g' : PS} (hf : ModY n f f') (hg : ModY n g g') :
    ModY n (f * g) (f' * g')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨q * g + f' * r, ?_⟩
  calc
    f * g - f' * g' = (f - f') * g + f' * (g - g') := by ring
    _ = (Y ^ n * q) * g + f' * (Y ^ n * r) := by rw [hq, hr]
    _ = Y ^ n * (q * g + f' * r) := by ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.hasLeading_order
statement:
theorem hasLeading_order {n : ℕ} {c : 𝔽₃} {f : PS}
    (hc : c ≠ 0) (h : HasLeading n c f) : PowerSeries.order f = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [PowerSeries.order_eq_nat]
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h
    have hcff := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff n) hq
    have heq : PowerSeries.coeff n f = c := by
      apply sub_eq_zero.mp
      simpa [HasLeading, ModY, Y, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul_X_pow,
        PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul', show ¬n + 1 ≤ n by omega] using hcff
    simpa [heq] using hc
  · intro i hi
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h
    have hcff := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff i) hq
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    simpa [HasLeading, ModY, Y, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul_X_pow,
      PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul', hi.ne,
      show ¬n + 1 ≤ i by omega] using hcff
