name: IwasawaTower.Series.factor_mul_log_term
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (1 + X ^ (j + 1)) *
        (X ^ (j + 1) * (1 + X ^ (j + 1))⁻¹) =
      X ^ (j + 1) *
        ((1 + X ^ (j + 1)) * (1 + X ^ (j + 1))⁻¹) := by ac_rfl
    _ = X ^ (j + 1) := by rw [one_add_X_pow_mul_inv, mul_one]

name: IwasawaTower.Series.shifted_factor
statement:
private theorem shifted_factor {s : ℕ} {e : PS} (hs : X ^ s = 1 + e) (j : ℕ) :
    1 + X ^ (s + j + 1) =
      (1 + X ^ (j + 1)) *
        (1 + e * (X ^ (j + 1) * (1 + X ^ (j + 1))⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  rw [show s + j + 1 = s + (j + 1) by omega, pow_add, hs]
  have hf := factor_mul_log_term j
  calc
    1 + (1 + e) * X ^ (j + 1) =
        (1 + X ^ (j + 1)) + e * X ^ (j + 1) := by ring
    _ = (1 + X ^ (j + 1)) +
        e * ((1 + X ^ (j + 1)) *
          (X ^ (j + 1) * (1 + X ^ (j + 1))⁻¹)) := by rw [hf]
    _ = (1 + X ^ (j + 1)) *
        (1 + e * (X ^ (j + 1) * (1 + X ^ (j + 1))⁻¹)) := by ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.product_one_add_mod
statement:
private theorem product_one_add_mod {N b : ℕ} {e : PS} (he : Vanishes N e) :
    ModY (2 * N)
      (∏ j ∈ Finset.range b,
        (1 + e * (X ^ (j + 1) * (1 + X ^ (j + 1))⁻¹)))
      (1 + e * L b)
proof:
:= by
  induction b with
  | zero => simp [L, ModY.refl]
  | succ b ih =>
      let q := X ^ (b + 1) * (1 + X ^ (b + 1))⁻¹
      have hmul : ModY (2 * N)
          ((∏ j ∈ Finset.range b,
              (1 + e * (X ^ (j + 1) * (1 + X ^ (j + 1))⁻¹))) * (1 + e * q))
          ((1 + e * L b) * (1 + e * q)) :=
        ModY.mul_right (1 + e * q) ih
      have hee : Vanishes (2 * N) (e * e) := by
        simpa [two_mul] using Vanishes.mul he he
      have hdrop : ModY (2 * N)
          ((1 + e * L b) * (1 + e * q))
          (1 + e * (L b + q)) := by
        obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Vanishes.mul_right (L b * q) hee
        refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
        calc
          (1 + e * L b) * (1 + e * q) - (1 + e * (L b + q)) =
              (e * e) * (L b * q) := by ring
          _ = Y ^ (2 * N) * u := hu
      simpa [Finset.prod_range_succ, L, Finset.sum_range_succ, q,
        Nat.add_assoc] using ModY.trans hmul hdrop

name: IwasawaTower.Series.product_one_add_second_order
statement:
private theorem product_one_add_second_order {N b : ℕ} {e : PS}
    (he : Vanishes N e) :
    ModY (3 * N)
      (∏ j ∈ Finset.range b,
        (1 + e * (X ^ (j + 1) * (1 + X ^ (j + 1))⁻¹)))
      (1 + e * L b + e ^ 2 * E b)
proof:
:= by
  induction b with
  | zero => simp [L, E, ModY.refl]
  | succ b ih =>
      let q := X ^ (b + 1) * (1 + X ^ (b + 1))⁻¹
      have hmul := ModY.mul_right (1 + e * q) ih
      have he3 : Vanishes (3 * N) (e ^ 3) := by
        obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := he
        refine ⟨u ^ 3, ?_⟩
        rw [hu, mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
        congr 2
        omega
      have hdrop : ModY (3 * N)
          ((1 + e * L b + e ^ 2 * E b) * (1 + e * q))
          (1 + e * (L b + q) + e ^ 2 * (E b + q * L b)) := by
        obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Vanishes.mul_right (E b * q) he3
        refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
        calc
          (1 + e * L b + e ^ 2 * E b) * (1 + e * q) -
              (1 + e * (L b + q) + e ^ 2 * (E b + q * L b)) =
              e ^ 3 * (E b * q) := by ring
          _ = Y ^ (3 * N) * u := hu
      simpa [Finset.prod_range_succ, L, E, Finset.sum_range_succ, q,
        mul_comm q] using ModY.trans hmul hdrop

name: IwasawaTower.Series.tail_first_order
statement:
theorem tail_first_order {N s b : ℕ} {e : PS} (he : Vanishes N e)
    (hs : X ^ s = 1 + e) :
    ModY (2 * N) (Tail s b) (A b * (1 + e * L b))
proof:
:= by
  have hp := product_one_add_mod (b := b) he
  have hexact : Tail s b =
      A b * ∏ j ∈ Finset.range b,
        (1 + e * (X ^ (j + 1) * (1 + X ^ (j + 1))⁻¹)) := by
    rw [Tail, A]
    simp_rw [shifted_factor hs]
    rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  rw [hexact]
  exact ModY.mul_left (A b) hp

name: IwasawaTower.Series.tail_second_order
statement:
theorem tail_second_order {N s b : ℕ} {e : PS} (he : Vanishes N e)
    (hs : X ^ s = 1 + e) :
    ModY (3 * N) (Tail s b) (A b * (1 + e * L b + e ^ 2 * E b))
proof:
:= by
  have hp := product_one_add_second_order (b := b) he
  have hexact : Tail s b =
      A b * ∏ j ∈ Finset.range b,
        (1 + e * (X ^ (j + 1) * (1 + X ^ (j + 1))⁻¹)) := by
    rw [Tail, A]
    simp_rw [shifted_factor hs]
    rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  rw [hexact]
  exact ModY.mul_left (A b) hp

name: IwasawaTower.Series.log_term_square
statement:
private theorem log_term_square (j : ℕ) :
    (X ^ (j + 1) * (1 + X ^ (j + 1))⁻¹) ^ 2 =
      X ^ (j + 1) * (1 + X ^ (j + 1))⁻¹ -
        X ^ (j + 1) * (1 + X ^ (j + 1))⁻¹ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let z := X ^ (j + 1)
  let d := 1 + z
  have hd : d * d⁻¹ = 1 := by
    simpa [d, z] using one_add_X_pow_mul_inv (j + 1)
  have hz : z ^ 2 = z * d - z := by
    simp [d]
    ring
  change (z * d⁻¹) ^ 2 = z * d⁻¹ - z * d⁻¹ ^ 2
  calc
    (z * d⁻¹) ^ 2 = z ^ 2 * d⁻¹ ^ 2 := by ring
    _ = (z * d - z) * d⁻¹ ^ 2 := by rw [hz]
    _ = z * d⁻¹ - z * d⁻¹ ^ 2 := by
      rw [pow_two]
      calc
        (z * d - z) * (d⁻¹ * d⁻¹) =
            z * d⁻¹ * (d * d⁻¹) - z * (d⁻¹ * d⁻¹) := by ring
        _ = z * d⁻¹ - z * (d⁻¹ * d⁻¹) := by rw [hd, mul_one]

name: IwasawaTower.Series.E_eq
statement: theorem E_eq (r : ℕ) : E r = -L r ^ 2 + L r - M r
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp [E, L, M]
  | succ r ih =>
      let q := X ^ (r + 1) * (1 + X ^ (r + 1))⁻¹
      let m := X ^ (r + 1) * (1 + X ^ (r + 1))⁻¹ ^ 2
      have hq : q ^ 2 = q - m := by
        simpa [q, m] using log_term_square r
      have hthree : (3 : PS) = 0 := CharP.cast_eq_zero (R := PS) 3
      have hE : E (r + 1) = E r + q * L r := by
        simp [E, q, Finset.sum_range_succ]
      have hL : L (r + 1) = L r + q := by
        simp [L, q, Finset.sum_range_succ]
      have hM : M (r + 1) = M r + m := by
        simp [M, m, Finset.sum_range_succ]
      rw [hE, hL, hM, ih]
      linear_combination hq + hthree * (L r * q)

name: IwasawaTower.Series.A_add
statement: theorem A_add (s b : ℕ) : A (s + b) = A s * Tail s b
proof:
:= by
  rw [A, Tail, Finset.prod_range_add]
  congr 1

name: IwasawaTower.Series.A_one_block
statement:
theorem A_one_block {N b : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY (2 * N) (A (N + b))
      (A N * A b * (1 + delta N * L b))
proof:
:= by
  rw [A_add]
  have ht := tail_first_order (b := b) (delta_vanishes N)
    (X_pow_eq_one_add_delta_of_power hN)
  simpa [mul_assoc] using ModY.mul_left (A N) ht

name: IwasawaTower.Series.X_two_mul_pow
statement:
private theorem X_two_mul_pow {N : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    X ^ (2 * N) = (1 + delta N) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [show 2 * N = N + N by omega, pow_add,
    X_pow_eq_one_add_delta_of_power hN]
  simp [pow_two]

name: IwasawaTower.Series.two_block_error_vanishes
statement:
private theorem two_block_error_vanishes {N : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    Vanishes N (X ^ (2 * N) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨-(2 : PS) + Y ^ N, ?_⟩
  rw [X_two_mul_pow hN, delta]
  ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.two_block_error_mod
statement:
private theorem two_block_error_mod {N : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY (2 * N) (X ^ (2 * N) - 1) (-delta N)
proof:
:= by
  have hthree : (3 : PS) = 0 := CharP.cast_eq_zero (R := PS) 3
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  have hpow : Y ^ (2 * N) = (Y ^ N) ^ 2 := by
    rw [pow_two, ← pow_add]
    congr 1
    omega
  rw [X_two_mul_pow hN, delta, hpow]
  calc
    (1 + -Y ^ N) ^ 2 - 1 - - -Y ^ N =
        (Y ^ N) ^ 2 - 3 * Y ^ N := by ring
    _ = (Y ^ N) ^ 2 := by rw [hthree, zero_mul, sub_zero]
    _ = (Y ^ N) ^ 2 * 1 := by ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.two_block_error_exact
statement:
private theorem two_block_error_exact {N : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    X ^ (2 * N) - 1 = -delta N + delta N ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hthree : (3 : PS) = 0 := CharP.cast_eq_zero (R := PS) 3
  rw [X_two_mul_pow hN]
  linear_combination hthree * delta N

name: IwasawaTower.Series.Y_pow_three_mul
statement: private theorem Y_pow_three_mul (N : ℕ) : Y ^ (3 * N) = (Y ^ N) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_mul]
  congr 1
  omega

name: IwasawaTower.Series.tail_two_blocks_second_order
proof:
:= by
  let e := X ^ (2 * N) - 1
  have ht := tail_second_order (b := N) (two_block_error_vanishes hN)
    (show X ^ (2 * N) = 1 + e by simp [e])
  have hfactor : ModY (3 * N)
      (1 + e * L N + e ^ 2 * E N)
      (1 - delta N * L N + delta N ^ 2 * (L N + E N)) := by
    refine ⟨(2 + Y ^ N) * E N, ?_⟩
    rw [show e = X ^ (2 * N) - 1 by rfl, two_block_error_exact hN,
      delta, Y_pow_three_mul]
    ring
  exact ModY.trans ht (ModY.mul (ModY.refl (3 * N) (A N)) hfactor)

name: IwasawaTower.Series.A_three_block_precise
statement:
theorem A_three_block_precise {N : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY (3 * N) (A (3 * N))
      (A N ^ 3 * (1 + delta N ^ 2 * M N))
proof:
:= by
  have ht1 := tail_second_order (b := N) (delta_vanishes N)
    (X_pow_eq_one_add_delta_of_power hN)
  have ha2 : ModY (3 * N) (A (2 * N))
      (A N ^ 2 * (1 + delta N * L N + delta N ^ 2 * E N)) := by
    rw [show 2 * N = N + N by omega, A_add]
    convert ModY.mul_left (A N) ht1 using 1 <;> ring
  have ht2 := tail_two_blocks_second_order hN
  have hsplit : A (3 * N) = A (2 * N) * Tail (2 * N) N := by
    rw [show 3 * N = 2 * N + N by omega, A_add]
  rw [hsplit]
  have hmul := ModY.mul ha2 ht2
  have halg : ModY (3 * N)
      ((1 + delta N * L N + delta N ^ 2 * E N) *
        (1 - delta N * L N + delta N ^ 2 * (L N + E N)))
      (1 + delta N ^ 2 * M N) := by
    refine ⟨-(L N) ^ 2 + Y ^ N * E N * (L N + E N), ?_⟩
    have hthree : (3 : PS) = 0 := CharP.cast_eq_zero (R := PS) 3
    rw [delta, Y_pow_three_mul, E_eq]
    linear_combination hthree * (Y ^ N) ^ 2 *
      (-L N ^ 2 + L N - M N)
  have hscaled := ModY.mul_left (A N ^ 3) halg
  exact ModY.trans (by convert hmul using 1 <;> ring) hscaled

name: IwasawaTower.Series.constantCoeff_M
statement: theorem constantCoeff_M (N : ℕ) : constantCoeff (M N) = (N : 𝔽₃)
proof:
:= by
  have hinv : (2 : 𝔽₃)⁻¹ = 2 :=
    ZMod.inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one 3 2 2 (by decide)
  have hsq : (2 : 𝔽₃) ^ 2 = 1 := by decide
  rw [M, map_sum]
  simp [hinv, hsq]

name: IwasawaTower.Series.M_vanishes_one_of_three_dvd
statement: theorem M_vanishes_one_of_three_dvd {N : ℕ} (hN : 3 ∣ N) : Vanishes 1 (M N)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : constantCoeff (M N) = 0 := by
    rw [constantCoeff_M]
    exact (CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff 𝔽₃ 3 N).2 hN
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := PowerSeries.X_dvd_iff.mpr hc
  exact ⟨q, by simpa [Y] using hq⟩

name: IwasawaTower.Series.A_three_block_cube
statement:
theorem A_three_block_cube {N : ℕ} (hpos : 0 < N) (hdiv : 3 ∣ N)
    (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY (2 * N + 1) (A (3 * N)) (A N ^ 3)
proof:
:= by
  have hprec := ModY.mono (by omega : 2 * N + 1 ≤ 3 * N)
    (A_three_block_precise hN)
  have hd2 : Vanishes (2 * N) (delta N ^ 2) := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := delta_vanishes N
    refine ⟨u ^ 2, ?_⟩
    rw [hu, mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
    congr 2
    omega
  have hcorr : Vanishes (2 * N + 1) (delta N ^ 2 * M N) := by
    simpa using Vanishes.mul hd2 (M_vanishes_one_of_three_dvd hdiv)
  have hdrop : ModY (2 * N + 1)
      (A N ^ 3 * (1 + delta N ^ 2 * M N)) (A N ^ 3) := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Vanishes.mul_left (A N ^ 3) hcorr
    exact ⟨u, by calc
      A N ^ 3 * (1 + delta N ^ 2 * M N) - A N ^ 3 =
          A N ^ 3 * (delta N ^ 2 * M N) := by ring
      _ = Y ^ (2 * N + 1) * u := hu⟩
  exact ModY.trans hprec hdrop

name: IwasawaTower.Series.tail_two_blocks
statement:
theorem tail_two_blocks {N b : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY (2 * N) (Tail (2 * N) b) (A b * (1 - delta N * L b))
proof:
:= by
  let e := X ^ (2 * N) - 1
  have he : Vanishes N e := two_block_error_vanishes hN
  have hs : X ^ (2 * N) = 1 + e := by simp [e]
  have ht := tail_first_order (b := b) he hs
  have hem : ModY (2 * N) e (-delta N) := two_block_error_mod hN
  have hone : ModY (2 * N) (1 + e * L b) (1 - delta N * L b) := by
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using ModY.add (ModY.refl (2 * N) 1)
      (ModY.mul_right (L b) hem)
  exact ModY.trans ht (ModY.mul (ModY.refl (2 * N) (A b)) hone)

name: IwasawaTower.Series.mul_linear_delta
statement:
private theorem mul_linear_delta (N : ℕ) (u v : PS) :
    ModY (2 * N)
      ((1 + delta N * u) * (1 + delta N * v))
      (1 + delta N * (u + v))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨u * v, ?_⟩
  rw [delta]
  have hpow : Y ^ (2 * N) = (Y ^ N) ^ 2 := by
    rw [pow_two, ← pow_add]
    congr 1
    omega
  rw [hpow]
  ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.delta_double_eq_neg
statement:
private theorem delta_double_eq_neg (N : ℕ) (u : PS) :
    1 + delta N * (u + u) = 1 - delta N * u
proof:
:= by
  have hthree : (3 : PS) = 0 := CharP.cast_eq_zero (R := PS) 3
  linear_combination hthree * (delta N * u)

name: IwasawaTower.Series.square_one_plus_delta
statement:
private theorem square_one_plus_delta (N : ℕ) (u : PS) :
    ModY (2 * N) ((1 + delta N * u) ^ 2) (1 - delta N * u)
proof:
:= by
  have h := mul_linear_delta N u u
  rw [pow_two]
  exact ModY.trans h (by rw [delta_double_eq_neg]; exact ModY.refl _ _)

name: IwasawaTower.Series.one_plus_mul_one_minus_delta
statement:
private theorem one_plus_mul_one_minus_delta (N : ℕ) (u v : PS) :
    ModY (2 * N)
      ((1 + delta N * u) * (1 - delta N * v))
      (1 + delta N * (u - v))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using mul_linear_delta N u (-v)

name: IwasawaTower.Series.A_two_blocks
statement:
theorem A_two_blocks {N b : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY (2 * N) (A (2 * N + b))
      (A N ^ 2 * A b * (1 + delta N * (L N - L b)))
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst : ModY (2 * N) (A (2 * N))
      (A N * A N * (1 + delta N * L N)) := by
    simpa [two_mul] using A_one_block (b := N) hN
  have htail := tail_two_blocks (b := b) hN
  rw [A_add]
  have hmul := ModY.mul hfirst htail
  have hlin := one_plus_mul_one_minus_delta N (L N) (L b)
  have hscaled := ModY.mul_left (A N ^ 2 * A b) hlin
  have hreassoc : ModY (2 * N) (A (2 * N) * Tail (2 * N) b)
      (A N ^ 2 * A b *
        ((1 + delta N * L N) * (1 - delta N * L b))) := by
    convert hmul using 1 <;> ring
  exact ModY.trans hreassoc hscaled

name: IwasawaTower.Series.weight_one_block
statement:
private theorem weight_one_block {N b : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    X ^ (N + b + 1) = X ^ (b + 1) * (1 + delta N)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show N + b + 1 = N + (b + 1) by omega, pow_add,
    X_pow_eq_one_add_delta_of_power hN]
  ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.weight_two_blocks
proof:
:= by
  have he := two_block_error_mod hN
  have hx : ModY (2 * N) (X ^ (2 * N)) (1 - delta N) := by
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using ModY.add (ModY.refl (2 * N) 1) he
  rw [show 2 * N + b + 1 = 2 * N + (b + 1) by omega, pow_add]
  simpa [mul_comm] using ModY.mul_left (X ^ (b + 1)) hx

name: IwasawaTower.Series.F_summand_one_block
statement:
theorem F_summand_one_block {N b : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY (2 * N)
      (X ^ (N + b + 1) * A (N + b) ^ 2)
      (A N ^ 2 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2) *
        (1 + delta N * (1 - L b)))
proof:
:= by
  have ha := A_one_block (b := b) hN
  have hasq := ModY.pow ha 2
  have hw : ModY (2 * N) (X ^ (N + b + 1))
      (X ^ (b + 1) * (1 + delta N)) := by
    rw [weight_one_block hN]
    exact ModY.refl _ _
  have hmul := ModY.mul hw hasq
  have hsquare := square_one_plus_delta N (L b)
  have hfactor := one_plus_mul_one_minus_delta N 1 (L b)
  let B := A N ^ 2 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)
  have hscaledSquare := ModY.mul_left (B * (1 + delta N)) hsquare
  have hscaledFactor := ModY.mul_left B hfactor
  have hstart : ModY (2 * N)
      (X ^ (N + b + 1) * A (N + b) ^ 2)
      (B * ((1 + delta N) * (1 + delta N * L b) ^ 2)) := by
    convert hmul using 1 <;> simp only [B] <;> ring
  have hmiddle : ModY (2 * N)
      (B * ((1 + delta N) * (1 + delta N * L b) ^ 2))
      (B * ((1 + delta N) * (1 - delta N * L b))) := by
    convert hscaledSquare using 1 <;> ring
  have hend : ModY (2 * N)
      (B * ((1 + delta N) * (1 - delta N * L b)))
      (B * (1 + delta N * (1 - L b))) := by
    convert hscaledFactor using 1 <;> ring
  exact ModY.trans hstart (ModY.trans hmiddle hend)

name: IwasawaTower.Series.F_summand_two_blocks
statement:
theorem F_summand_two_blocks {N b : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY (2 * N)
      (X ^ (2 * N + b + 1) * A (2 * N + b) ^ 2)
      (A N ^ 4 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2) *
        (1 - delta N * (1 + L N - L b)))
proof:
:= by
  have ha := A_two_blocks (b := b) hN
  have hasq := ModY.pow ha 2
  have hw := weight_two_blocks (b := b) hN
  have hmul := ModY.mul hw hasq
  have hsquare := square_one_plus_delta N (L N - L b)
  have hfactor := mul_linear_delta N (-1) (-(L N - L b))
  let B := A N ^ 4 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)
  have hscaledSquare := ModY.mul_left (B * (1 - delta N)) hsquare
  have hscaledFactor := ModY.mul_left B hfactor
  have hstart : ModY (2 * N)
      (X ^ (2 * N + b + 1) * A (2 * N + b) ^ 2)
      (B * ((1 - delta N) * (1 + delta N * (L N - L b)) ^ 2)) := by
    convert hmul using 1 <;> simp only [B] <;> ring
  have hmiddle : ModY (2 * N)
      (B * ((1 - delta N) * (1 + delta N * (L N - L b)) ^ 2))
      (B * ((1 - delta N) * (1 - delta N * (L N - L b)))) := by
    convert hscaledSquare using 1 <;> ring
  have hend : ModY (2 * N)
      (B * ((1 - delta N) * (1 - delta N * (L N - L b))))
      (B * (1 - delta N * (1 + L N - L b))) := by
    convert hscaledFactor using 1 <;> ring
  exact ModY.trans hstart (ModY.trans hmiddle hend)

name: IwasawaTower.Series.F_three_split
statement:
private theorem F_three_split (N : ℕ) :
    F (3 * N) = F N +
      (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N, X ^ (N + b + 1) * A (N + b) ^ 2) +
      (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N, X ^ (2 * N + b + 1) * A (2 * N + b) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [F]
  rw [show 3 * N = N + (N + N) by omega, Finset.sum_range_add,
    Finset.sum_range_add]
  have hidx (b : ℕ) : N + (N + b) = 2 * N + b := by omega
  simp_rw [hidx]
  ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.sum_first_block_target
statement:
private theorem sum_first_block_target (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
      A N ^ 2 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2) *
        (1 + delta N * (1 - L b))) =
      A N ^ 2 * F N + delta N * A N ^ 2 * W N
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [show ∀ b : ℕ,
      A N ^ 2 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2) *
          (1 + delta N * (1 - L b)) =
        A N ^ 2 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2) +
          (delta N * A N ^ 2) *
            (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2 * (1 - L b)) by
      intro b
      ring]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  rfl

name: IwasawaTower.Series.sum_second_block_target
statement:
private theorem sum_second_block_target (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
      A N ^ 4 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2) *
        (1 - delta N * (1 + L N - L b))) =
      A N ^ 4 * F N - delta N * A N ^ 4 * (L N * F N + W N)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [show ∀ b : ℕ,
      A N ^ 4 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2) *
          (1 - delta N * (1 + L N - L b)) =
        A N ^ 4 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2) -
          (delta N * A N ^ 4) *
            (L N * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2) +
              X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2 * (1 - L b)) by
      intro b
      ring]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  rfl

name: IwasawaTower.Series.F_three_block_precise
statement:
theorem F_three_block_precise {N : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY (2 * N) (F (3 * N))
      (F N * (1 + A N ^ 2 + A N ^ 4) +
        delta N *
          (A N ^ 2 * (1 - A N ^ 2) * W N -
            A N ^ 4 * L N * F N))
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst : ModY (2 * N)
      (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N, X ^ (N + b + 1) * A (N + b) ^ 2)
      (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
        A N ^ 2 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2) *
          (1 + delta N * (1 - L b))) :=
    ModY.sum _ fun b hb ↦ F_summand_one_block hN
  have hsecond : ModY (2 * N)
      (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N, X ^ (2 * N + b + 1) * A (2 * N + b) ^ 2)
      (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
        A N ^ 4 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2) *
          (1 - delta N * (1 + L N - L b))) :=
    ModY.sum _ fun b hb ↦ F_summand_two_blocks hN
  rw [F_three_split]
  have hall := ModY.add (ModY.add (ModY.refl (2 * N) (F N)) hfirst) hsecond
  rw [sum_first_block_target, sum_second_block_target] at hall
  refine ModY.trans hall ?_
  exact ⟨0, by ring⟩

name: IwasawaTower.Series.shifted_log_term_second_order_exact
statement:
private theorem shifted_log_term_second_order_exact {s j : ℕ} {e : PS}
    (hs : X ^ s = 1 + e) :
    logTerm (s + j) -
        (logTerm j + e * logSlope j - e ^ 2 * logCurve j) =
      e ^ 3 *
        ((X ^ (j + 1)) ^ 3 *
          (1 + X ^ (s + j + 1))⁻¹ * (1 + X ^ (j + 1))⁻¹ ^ 3)
proof:
:= by
  let z := X ^ (j + 1)
  let d := 1 + z
  let d' := 1 + (1 + e) * z
  have hd : d * d⁻¹ = 1 := by
    simpa [d, z] using one_add_X_pow_mul_inv (j + 1)
  have hd' : d' * d'⁻¹ = 1 := by
    have hp : d' = 1 + X ^ (s + j + 1) := by
      rw [show s + j + 1 = s + (j + 1) by omega, pow_add, hs]
    rw [hp]
    exact one_add_X_pow_mul_inv (s + j + 1)
  have hfirst :
      (1 + e) * z * d'⁻¹ - z * d⁻¹ = e * z * d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹ := by
    calc
      (1 + e) * z * d'⁻¹ - z * d⁻¹ =
          ((1 + e) * z * d - z * d') * (d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹) := by
            calc
              (1 + e) * z * d'⁻¹ - z * d⁻¹ =
                  (1 + e) * z * d'⁻¹ * (d * d⁻¹) -
                    z * d⁻¹ * (d' * d'⁻¹) := by rw [hd, hd', mul_one, mul_one]
              _ = ((1 + e) * z * d - z * d') * (d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹) := by ring
      _ = e * z * d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹ := by simp [d', d]; ring
  have hinv₁ : d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹ - d⁻¹ ^ 2 =
      -e * z * d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹ - d⁻¹ ^ 2 =
          d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹ * (d * d⁻¹) - d⁻¹ ^ 2 * (d' * d'⁻¹) := by
            rw [hd, hd', mul_one, mul_one]
      _ = (d - d') * d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹ ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = -e * z * d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹ ^ 2 := by simp [d', d]; ring
  have hinv₂ : d⁻¹ - d'⁻¹ = e * z * d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹ := by
    calc
      d⁻¹ - d'⁻¹ = d⁻¹ * (d' * d'⁻¹) - d'⁻¹ * (d * d⁻¹) := by
        rw [hd, hd', mul_one, mul_one]
      _ = (d' - d) * d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹ := by ring
      _ = e * z * d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹ := by
        have hsub : d' - d = e * z := by simp only [d', d]; ring
        rw [hsub]
  have hsecond :
      e * z * d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹ - e * (z * d⁻¹ ^ 2) +
          e ^ 2 * (z ^ 2 * d⁻¹ ^ 3) =
        e ^ 3 * (z ^ 3 * d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹ ^ 3) := by
    calc
      e * z * d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹ - e * (z * d⁻¹ ^ 2) +
          e ^ 2 * (z ^ 2 * d⁻¹ ^ 3) =
        e * z * (d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹ - d⁻¹ ^ 2) +
          e ^ 2 * (z ^ 2 * d⁻¹ ^ 3) := by ring
      _ = e ^ 2 * z ^ 2 * d⁻¹ ^ 2 * (d⁻¹ - d'⁻¹) := by
        rw [hinv₁]
        ring
      _ = e ^ 3 * (z ^ 3 * d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹ ^ 3) := by rw [hinv₂]; ring
  have hmain : (1 + e) * z * d'⁻¹ -
      (z * d⁻¹ + e * (z * d⁻¹ ^ 2) - e ^ 2 * (z ^ 2 * d⁻¹ ^ 3)) =
      e ^ 3 * (z ^ 3 * d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹ ^ 3) := by
    rw [show (1 + e) * z * d'⁻¹ -
        (z * d⁻¹ + e * (z * d⁻¹ ^ 2) - e ^ 2 * (z ^ 2 * d⁻¹ ^ 3)) =
      ((1 + e) * z * d'⁻¹ - z * d⁻¹) - e * (z * d⁻¹ ^ 2) +
        e ^ 2 * (z ^ 2 * d⁻¹ ^ 3) by ring, hfirst]
    exact hsecond
  have hzshift : X ^ (s + j + 1) = (1 + e) * z := by
    rw [show s + j + 1 = s + (j + 1) by omega, pow_add, hs]
  simp only [logTerm, logSlope, logCurve]
  rw [hzshift]
  simpa only [z, d, d'] using hmain

name: IwasawaTower.Series.shifted_log_term_second_order
statement:
private theorem shifted_log_term_second_order {N s j : ℕ} {e : PS}
    (he : Vanishes N e) (hs : X ^ s = 1 + e) :
    ModY (3 * N) (logTerm (s + j))
      (logTerm j + e * logSlope j - e ^ 2 * logCurve j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := he
  refine ⟨u ^ 3 *
      ((X ^ (j + 1)) ^ 3 * (1 + X ^ (s + j + 1))⁻¹ *
        (1 + X ^ (j + 1))⁻¹ ^ 3), ?_⟩
  rw [shifted_log_term_second_order_exact hs, hu, mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
  rw [Nat.mul_comm N 3]
  ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.shifted_log_term_first_order
proof:
:= by
  have hprec := ModY.mono (by omega : 2 * N ≤ 3 * N)
    (shifted_log_term_second_order (j := j) he hs)
  have he2 : Vanishes (2 * N) (e ^ 2) := by
    rw [pow_two]
    convert Vanishes.mul he he using 1 <;> omega
  have hdrop : ModY (2 * N)
      (logTerm j + e * logSlope j - e ^ 2 * logCurve j)
      (logTerm j + e * logSlope j) := by
    simpa using ModY.sub (ModY.refl (2 * N) (logTerm j + e * logSlope j))
      (Vanishes.modY_zero (Vanishes.mul_right (logCurve j) he2))
  exact ModY.trans hprec hdrop

name: IwasawaTower.Series.logSlope_add_logCurve
statement:
private theorem logSlope_add_logCurve (j : ℕ) :
    logSlope j + logCurve j = logTerm j - logTerm j ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  let z := X ^ (j + 1)
  let d := 1 + z
  have hd : d * d⁻¹ = 1 := by
    simpa [d, z] using one_add_X_pow_mul_inv (j + 1)
  have hone : 1 - z * d⁻¹ = d⁻¹ := by
    calc
      1 - z * d⁻¹ = d * d⁻¹ - z * d⁻¹ := by rw [hd]
      _ = d⁻¹ := by simp [d]; ring
  have hlocal : z * d⁻¹ ^ 2 + z ^ 2 * d⁻¹ ^ 3 =
      z * d⁻¹ - (z * d⁻¹) ^ 3 := by
    symm
    calc
      z * d⁻¹ - (z * d⁻¹) ^ 3 =
          (z * d⁻¹) * (1 - z * d⁻¹) * (1 + z * d⁻¹) := by ring
      _ = z * d⁻¹ ^ 2 + z ^ 2 * d⁻¹ ^ 3 := by rw [hone]; ring
  simpa only [logTerm, logSlope, logCurve, z, d] using hlocal

name: IwasawaTower.Series.log_term_three_blocks
statement:
private theorem log_term_three_blocks {N j : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY (3 * N)
      (logTerm j + logTerm (N + j) + logTerm (2 * N + j))
      (delta N ^ 2 * (logTerm j - logTerm j ^ 3))
proof:
:= by
  let e := X ^ (2 * N) - 1
  have h₁ := shifted_log_term_second_order (j := j) (delta_vanishes N)
    (X_pow_eq_one_add_delta_of_power hN)
  have h₂ := shifted_log_term_second_order (j := j)
    (two_block_error_vanishes hN)
    (show X ^ (2 * N) = 1 + e by simp [e])
  have hall := ModY.add (ModY.add (ModY.refl (3 * N) (logTerm j)) h₁) h₂
  refine ModY.trans hall ?_
  refine ⟨-(2 + Y ^ N) * logCurve j, ?_⟩
  have hthree : (3 : PS) = 0 := CharP.cast_eq_zero (R := PS) 3
  rw [two_block_error_exact hN,
    ← logSlope_add_logCurve, delta, Y_pow_three_mul]
  linear_combination hthree * (logTerm j - Y ^ (2 * N) * logCurve j)

name: IwasawaTower.Series.L_three_split
proof:
:= by
  simp only [L, logTerm]
  rw [show 3 * N = N + (N + N) by omega, Finset.sum_range_add,
    Finset.sum_range_add]
  have hidx (j : ℕ) : N + (N + j) = 2 * N + j := by omega
  simp_rw [hidx]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.L_three_block_precise
statement:
theorem L_three_block_precise {N : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY (3 * N) (L (3 * N)) (delta N ^ 2 * (L N - L N ^ 3))
proof:
:= by
  rw [L_three_split]
  have hall : ModY (3 * N)
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
        (logTerm j + logTerm (N + j) + logTerm (2 * N + j)))
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
        delta N ^ 2 * (logTerm j - logTerm j ^ 3)) :=
    ModY.sum (Finset.range N) fun j hj ↦ log_term_three_blocks (j := j) hN
  refine ModY.trans hall ?_
  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  simp only [L, logTerm]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← sum_pow_char]
  ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.logSlope_eq_logTerm_sub_sq
statement:
private theorem logSlope_eq_logTerm_sub_sq (j : ℕ) :
    logSlope j = logTerm j - logTerm j ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := log_term_square j
  simp only [logSlope, logTerm] at h ⊢
  linear_combination h

name: IwasawaTower.Series.log_slope_three_blocks
statement:
private theorem log_slope_three_blocks {N j : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY (3 * N)
      (logSlope j + logSlope (N + j) + logSlope (2 * N + j))
      (delta N ^ 2 * logSlope j)
proof:
:= by
  let d := delta N
  let l := logTerm j
  let m := logSlope j
  let c := logCurve j
  let e := X ^ (2 * N) - 1
  have h₁l := shifted_log_term_second_order (j := j) (delta_vanishes N)
    (X_pow_eq_one_add_delta_of_power hN)
  have h₂l₀ := shifted_log_term_second_order (j := j)
    (two_block_error_vanishes hN)
    (show X ^ (2 * N) = 1 + e by simp [e])
  have h₂target : ModY (3 * N)
      (l + e * m - e ^ 2 * c)
      (l - d * m + d ^ 2 * (m - c)) := by
    refine ⟨-(2 - d) * c, ?_⟩
    rw [show e = X ^ (2 * N) - 1 by rfl, two_block_error_exact hN]
    dsimp only [d]
    rw [delta, Y_pow_three_mul]
    ring
  have h₂l : ModY (3 * N) (logTerm (2 * N + j))
      (l - d * m + d ^ 2 * (m - c)) := by
    exact ModY.trans (by simpa only [l, m, c] using h₂l₀) h₂target
  have h₁ : ModY (3 * N) (logSlope (N + j))
      ((l + d * m - d ^ 2 * c) - (l + d * m - d ^ 2 * c) ^ 2) := by
    rw [logSlope_eq_logTerm_sub_sq]
    exact ModY.sub h₁l (ModY.pow h₁l 2)
  have h₂ : ModY (3 * N) (logSlope (2 * N + j))
      ((l - d * m + d ^ 2 * (m - c)) -
        (l - d * m + d ^ 2 * (m - c)) ^ 2) := by
    rw [logSlope_eq_logTerm_sub_sq]
    exact ModY.sub h₂l (ModY.pow h₂l 2)
  have hall := ModY.add
    (ModY.add (ModY.refl (3 * N) (logSlope j)) h₁) h₂
  refine ModY.trans hall ?_
  have hm : m = l - l ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [m, l] using logSlope_eq_logTerm_sub_sq j
  have hc : c = l ^ 2 - l ^ 3 := by
    have h := logSlope_add_logCurve j
    change m + c = l - l ^ 3 at h
    rw [hm] at h
    linear_combination h
  let q : PS := -(l ^ 4 + l ^ 3 + l ^ 2) +
    d * (l ^ 6 - l ^ 4 + l ^ 3 - l ^ 2)
  refine ⟨-q, ?_⟩
  have hthree : (3 : PS) = 0 := CharP.cast_eq_zero (R := PS) 3
  rw [logSlope_eq_logTerm_sub_sq j]
  rw [hm, hc]
  dsimp only [q, d, l, m, c]
  rw [delta, Y_pow_three_mul]
  linear_combination hthree *
    (-logTerm j *
      ((-Y ^ N) ^ 4 * logTerm j ^ 5 -
        2 * (-Y ^ N) ^ 4 * logTerm j ^ 4 +
        2 * (-Y ^ N) ^ 4 * logTerm j ^ 3 -
        (-Y ^ N) ^ 4 * logTerm j ^ 2 -
        (-Y ^ N) ^ 3 * logTerm j ^ 3 +
        (-Y ^ N) ^ 3 * logTerm j ^ 2 -
        (-Y ^ N) ^ 3 * logTerm j +
        2 * (-Y ^ N) ^ 2 * logTerm j ^ 3 -
        4 * (-Y ^ N) ^ 2 * logTerm j ^ 2 +
        2 * (-Y ^ N) ^ 2 * logTerm j + logTerm j - 1))

name: IwasawaTower.Series.M_three_split
proof:
:= by
  simp only [M, logSlope]
  rw [show 3 * N = N + (N + N) by omega, Finset.sum_range_add,
    Finset.sum_range_add]
  have hidx (j : ℕ) : N + (N + j) = 2 * N + j := by omega
  simp_rw [hidx]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.M_three_block_precise
statement:
theorem M_three_block_precise {N : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY (3 * N) (M (3 * N)) (delta N ^ 2 * M N)
proof:
:= by
  rw [M_three_split]
  have hall : ModY (3 * N)
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
        (logSlope j + logSlope (N + j) + logSlope (2 * N + j)))
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, delta N ^ 2 * logSlope j) :=
    ModY.sum (Finset.range N) fun j hj ↦ log_slope_three_blocks (j := j) hN
  refine ModY.trans hall ?_
  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  simp only [M, logSlope]
  ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.shifted_log_term
statement:
private theorem shifted_log_term {N s j : ℕ} {e : PS} (he : Vanishes N e)
    (hs : X ^ s = 1 + e) :
    ModY N
      (X ^ (s + j + 1) * (1 + X ^ (s + j + 1))⁻¹)
      (X ^ (j + 1) * (1 + X ^ (j + 1))⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  let z := X ^ (j + 1)
  let d := 1 + z
  let d' := 1 + (1 + e) * z
  have hd : d * d⁻¹ = 1 := by
    simpa [d, z] using one_add_X_pow_mul_inv (j + 1)
  have hd' : d' * d'⁻¹ = 1 := by
    have hp : d' = 1 + X ^ (s + j + 1) := by
      rw [show s + j + 1 = s + (j + 1) by omega, pow_add, hs]
    rw [hp]
    exact one_add_X_pow_mul_inv (s + j + 1)
  have hdiff :
      z * (1 + e) * d'⁻¹ - z * d⁻¹ =
        e * (z * d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹) := by
    calc
      z * (1 + e) * d'⁻¹ - z * d⁻¹ =
          (z * (1 + e) * d - z * d') * (d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹) := by
            calc
              z * (1 + e) * d'⁻¹ - z * d⁻¹ =
                  z * (1 + e) * d'⁻¹ * (d * d⁻¹) -
                    z * d⁻¹ * (d' * d'⁻¹) := by rw [hd, hd', mul_one, mul_one]
              _ = (z * (1 + e) * d - z * d') * (d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹) := by ring
      _ = e * (z * d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹) := by simp [d', d]; ring
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := he
  refine ⟨u * (z * d'⁻¹ * d⁻¹), ?_⟩
  rw [show s + j + 1 = s + (j + 1) by omega, pow_add, hs]
  change (1 + e) * z * d'⁻¹ - z * d⁻¹ = _
  rw [mul_comm (1 + e) z]
  rw [hdiff, hu]
  ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.L_add
statement:
private theorem L_add (s b : ℕ) :
    L (s + b) = L s +
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range b,
        X ^ (s + j + 1) * (1 + X ^ (s + j + 1))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [L, Finset.sum_range_add]
  congr 1

name: IwasawaTower.Series.L_shift
proof:
:= by
  rw [L_add]
  have hsum : ModY N
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range b,
        X ^ (s + j + 1) * (1 + X ^ (s + j + 1))⁻¹)
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range b,
        X ^ (j + 1) * (1 + X ^ (j + 1))⁻¹) :=
    ModY.sum _ fun j hj ↦ shifted_log_term he hs
  simpa [L] using ModY.add (ModY.refl N (L s)) hsum

name: IwasawaTower.Series.L_one_block
statement:
theorem L_one_block {N b : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY N (L (N + b)) (L N + L b)
proof:
:=
  L_shift (delta_vanishes N) (X_pow_eq_one_add_delta_of_power hN)

name: IwasawaTower.Series.L_two_blocks
statement:
theorem L_two_blocks {N b : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY N (L (2 * N + b)) (-L N + L b)
proof:
:= by
  let e := X ^ (2 * N) - 1
  have hshift : ModY N (L (2 * N + b)) (L (2 * N) + L b) :=
    L_shift (two_block_error_vanishes hN) (by simp [e])
  have htwo : ModY N (L (2 * N)) (L N + L N) := by
    simpa [two_mul] using L_one_block (b := N) hN
  have hreplace := ModY.add htwo (ModY.refl N (L b))
  have hthree : (3 : PS) = 0 := CharP.cast_eq_zero (R := PS) 3
  refine ModY.trans hshift (ModY.trans hreplace ?_)
  exact ⟨0, by
    have heq : L N + L N = -L N := by linear_combination hthree * L N
    rw [heq]
    ring⟩

name: IwasawaTower.Series.shifted_logSlope
proof:
:= by
  have hl := shifted_log_term (j := j) he hs
  rw [logSlope_eq_logTerm_sub_sq, logSlope_eq_logTerm_sub_sq]
  exact ModY.sub hl (ModY.pow hl 2)

name: IwasawaTower.Series.M_add
statement:
private theorem M_add (s b : ℕ) :
    M (s + b) = M s + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, logSlope (s + j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [M, Finset.sum_range_add]
  congr 1

name: IwasawaTower.Series.M_shift
proof:
:= by
  rw [M_add]
  have hsum : ModY N
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, logSlope (s + j))
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, logSlope j) :=
    ModY.sum _ fun j hj ↦ shifted_logSlope he hs
  simpa only [M, logSlope] using ModY.add (ModY.refl N (M s)) hsum

name: IwasawaTower.Series.M_one_block
statement:
theorem M_one_block {N b : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY N (M (N + b)) (M N + M b)
proof:
:=
  M_shift (delta_vanishes N) (X_pow_eq_one_add_delta_of_power hN)

name: IwasawaTower.Series.M_two_blocks
statement:
theorem M_two_blocks {N b : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY N (M (2 * N + b)) (-M N + M b)
proof:
:= by
  let e := X ^ (2 * N) - 1
  have hshift : ModY N (M (2 * N + b)) (M (2 * N) + M b) :=
    M_shift (two_block_error_vanishes hN) (by simp [e])
  have htwo : ModY N (M (2 * N)) (M N + M N) := by
    simpa [two_mul] using M_one_block (b := N) hN
  have hreplace := ModY.add htwo (ModY.refl N (M b))
  have hthree : (3 : PS) = 0 := CharP.cast_eq_zero (R := PS) 3
  refine ModY.trans hshift (ModY.trans hreplace ?_)
  exact ⟨0, by
    have heq : M N + M N = -M N := by linear_combination hthree * M N
    rw [heq]
    ring⟩

name: IwasawaTower.Series.L_shift_precise
proof:
:= by
  rw [L_add]
  have hsum : ModY (2 * N)
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range b,
        X ^ (s + j + 1) * (1 + X ^ (s + j + 1))⁻¹)
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, (logTerm j + e * logSlope j)) :=
    ModY.sum _ fun j hj ↦ by
      simpa only [logTerm] using shifted_log_term_first_order (j := j) he hs
  have hall := ModY.add (ModY.refl (2 * N) (L s)) hsum
  refine ModY.trans hall ?_
  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  simp only [L, M, logTerm, logSlope]
  ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.L_one_block_precise
statement:
theorem L_one_block_precise {N b : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY (2 * N) (L (N + b)) (L N + L b + delta N * M b)
proof:
:=
  L_shift_precise (delta_vanishes N) (X_pow_eq_one_add_delta_of_power hN)

name: IwasawaTower.Series.L_two_blocks_precise
statement:
theorem L_two_blocks_precise {N b : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY (2 * N) (L (2 * N + b))
      (-L N + L b + delta N * (M N - M b))
proof:
:= by
  let e := X ^ (2 * N) - 1
  have hshift := L_shift_precise (b := b) (two_block_error_vanishes hN)
    (show X ^ (2 * N) = 1 + e by simp [e])
  have htwo : ModY (2 * N) (L (2 * N))
      (L N + L N + delta N * M N) := by
    simpa [two_mul] using L_one_block_precise (b := N) hN
  change ModY (2 * N) (L (2 * N + b))
    (L (2 * N) + L b + e * M b) at hshift
  have hreplace : ModY (2 * N)
      (L (2 * N) + L b + e * M b)
      (L N + L N + delta N * M N + (L b + e * M b)) := by
    convert ModY.add htwo (ModY.refl (2 * N) (L b + e * M b)) using 1 <;> ring
  refine ModY.trans hshift (ModY.trans hreplace ?_)
  refine ⟨M b, ?_⟩
  have hthree : (3 : PS) = 0 := CharP.cast_eq_zero (R := PS) 3
  have hpow : Y ^ (2 * N) = (Y ^ N) ^ 2 := by
    rw [pow_two, ← pow_add]
    congr 1
    omega
  rw [show e = X ^ (2 * N) - 1 by rfl, two_block_error_exact hN,
    delta, hpow]
  linear_combination hthree * L N

name: IwasawaTower.Series.drop_delta_linear
statement:
private theorem drop_delta_linear (N : ℕ) (u v : PS) :
    ModY N (u * (1 + delta N * v)) u
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨-(u * v), ?_⟩
  rw [delta]
  ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.F_summand_one_block_coarse
proof:
:= by
  refine ModY.trans (ModY.mono (by omega) (F_summand_one_block (b := b) hN)) ?_
  simpa using drop_delta_linear N
    (A N ^ 2 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)) (1 - L b)

name: IwasawaTower.Series.F_summand_two_blocks_coarse
proof:
:= by
  refine ModY.trans (ModY.mono (by omega) (F_summand_two_blocks (b := b) hN)) ?_
  have h := drop_delta_linear N
    (A N ^ 4 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)) (-(1 + L N - L b))
  convert h using 1 <;> ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.H_three_split
statement:
private theorem H_three_split (N : ℕ) :
    H (3 * N) = H N +
      (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
        X ^ (N + b + 1) * A (N + b) ^ 2 *
          ((1 - L (N + b)) ^ 2 - M (N + b))) +
      (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
        X ^ (2 * N + b + 1) * A (2 * N + b) ^ 2 *
          ((1 - L (2 * N + b)) ^ 2 - M (2 * N + b)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [H]
  rw [show 3 * N = N + (N + N) by omega, Finset.sum_range_add,
    Finset.sum_range_add]
  have hidx (b : ℕ) : N + (N + b) = 2 * N + b := by omega
  simp_rw [hidx]
  ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.sum_H_first_target
statement:
private theorem sum_H_first_target (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
      (A N ^ 2 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)) *
        ((1 - (L N + L b)) ^ 2 - (M N + M b))) =
      A N ^ 2 * (H N + L N * W N + (L N ^ 2 - M N) * F N)
proof:
:= by
  have hthree : (3 : PS) = 0 := CharP.cast_eq_zero (R := PS) 3
  simp_rw [show ∀ b : ℕ,
      (A N ^ 2 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)) *
          ((1 - (L N + L b)) ^ 2 - (M N + M b)) =
        A N ^ 2 *
          (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2 * ((1 - L b) ^ 2 - M b) +
            L N * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2 * (1 - L b)) +
            (L N ^ 2 - M N) * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)) by
      intro b
      linear_combination hthree *
        (A N ^ 2 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2) * L N * (L b - 1))]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  rfl

name: IwasawaTower.Series.sum_H_second_target
statement:
private theorem sum_H_second_target (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
      (A N ^ 4 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)) *
        ((1 - (-L N + L b)) ^ 2 - (-M N + M b))) =
      A N ^ 4 * (H N - L N * W N + (L N ^ 2 + M N) * F N)
proof:
:= by
  have hthree : (3 : PS) = 0 := CharP.cast_eq_zero (R := PS) 3
  simp_rw [show ∀ b : ℕ,
      (A N ^ 4 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)) *
          ((1 - (-L N + L b)) ^ 2 - (-M N + M b)) =
        A N ^ 4 *
          (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2 * ((1 - L b) ^ 2 - M b) -
            L N * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2 * (1 - L b)) +
            (L N ^ 2 + M N) * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)) by
      intro b
      linear_combination hthree *
        (-(A N ^ 4 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2) * L N * (L b - 1)))]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  rfl

name: IwasawaTower.Series.H_three_block_coarse
statement:
theorem H_three_block_coarse {N : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY N (H (3 * N))
      (H N * (1 + A N ^ 2 + A N ^ 4) +
        L N * W N * (A N ^ 2 - A N ^ 4) +
        F N *
          (A N ^ 2 * (L N ^ 2 - M N) +
            A N ^ 4 * (L N ^ 2 + M N)))
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst : ModY N
      (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
        X ^ (N + b + 1) * A (N + b) ^ 2 *
          ((1 - L (N + b)) ^ 2 - M (N + b)))
      (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
        (A N ^ 2 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)) *
          ((1 - (L N + L b)) ^ 2 - (M N + M b))) :=
    ModY.sum _ fun b hb ↦ ModY.mul
      (F_summand_one_block_coarse hN)
      (ModY.sub
        (ModY.pow (ModY.sub (ModY.refl N 1) (L_one_block hN)) 2)
        (M_one_block hN))
  have hsecond : ModY N
      (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
        X ^ (2 * N + b + 1) * A (2 * N + b) ^ 2 *
          ((1 - L (2 * N + b)) ^ 2 - M (2 * N + b)))
      (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
        (A N ^ 4 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)) *
          ((1 - (-L N + L b)) ^ 2 - (-M N + M b))) :=
    ModY.sum _ fun b hb ↦ ModY.mul
      (F_summand_two_blocks_coarse hN)
      (ModY.sub
        (ModY.pow (ModY.sub (ModY.refl N 1) (L_two_blocks hN)) 2)
        (M_two_blocks hN))
  rw [H_three_split]
  have hall := ModY.add (ModY.add (ModY.refl N (H N)) hfirst) hsecond
  rw [sum_H_first_target, sum_H_second_target] at hall
  refine ModY.trans hall ?_
  exact ⟨0, by ring⟩

name: IwasawaTower.Series.W_three_split
statement:
private theorem W_three_split (N : ℕ) :
    W (3 * N) = W N +
      (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
        X ^ (N + b + 1) * A (N + b) ^ 2 * (1 - L (N + b))) +
      (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
        X ^ (2 * N + b + 1) * A (2 * N + b) ^ 2 * (1 - L (2 * N + b)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [W]
  rw [show 3 * N = N + (N + N) by omega, Finset.sum_range_add,
    Finset.sum_range_add]
  have hidx (b : ℕ) : N + (N + b) = 2 * N + b := by omega
  simp_rw [hidx]
  ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.sum_W_first_target
statement:
private theorem sum_W_first_target (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
      (A N ^ 2 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)) * (1 - (L N + L b))) =
      A N ^ 2 * (W N - L N * F N)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [show ∀ b : ℕ,
      (A N ^ 2 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)) * (1 - (L N + L b)) =
        A N ^ 2 *
          (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2 * (1 - L b) -
            L N * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)) by intro b; ring]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  rfl

name: IwasawaTower.Series.sum_W_second_target
statement:
private theorem sum_W_second_target (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
      (A N ^ 4 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)) * (1 - (-L N + L b))) =
      A N ^ 4 * (W N + L N * F N)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [show ∀ b : ℕ,
      (A N ^ 4 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)) * (1 - (-L N + L b)) =
        A N ^ 4 *
          (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2 * (1 - L b) +
            L N * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)) by intro b; ring]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  rfl

name: IwasawaTower.Series.W_summand_one_block_precise
statement:
private theorem W_summand_one_block_precise {N b : ℕ}
    (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY (2 * N)
      (X ^ (N + b + 1) * A (N + b) ^ 2 * (1 - L (N + b)))
      (A N ^ 2 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2) *
        ((1 - L N - L b) + delta N *
          ((1 - L b) * (1 - L N - L b) - M b)))
proof:
:= by
  have hf := F_summand_one_block (b := b) hN
  have hl := ModY.sub (ModY.refl (2 * N) 1) (L_one_block_precise (b := b) hN)
  have hmul := ModY.mul hf hl
  let C := A N ^ 2 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)
  let a := 1 - L b
  let c := 1 - L N - L b
  have halg : ModY (2 * N)
      (C * (1 + delta N * a) * (1 - (L N + L b + delta N * M b)))
      (C * (c + delta N * (a * c - M b))) := by
    refine ⟨-(C * a * M b), ?_⟩
    have hpow : Y ^ (2 * N) = (Y ^ N) ^ 2 := by
      rw [pow_two, ← pow_add]
      congr 1
      omega
    rw [delta, hpow]
    simp only [C, a, c]
    ring
  exact ModY.trans (by convert hmul using 1 <;> simp only [C, a] <;> ring) halg

name: IwasawaTower.Series.W_summand_two_blocks_precise
statement:
private theorem W_summand_two_blocks_precise {N b : ℕ}
    (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY (2 * N)
      (X ^ (2 * N + b + 1) * A (2 * N + b) ^ 2 * (1 - L (2 * N + b)))
      (A N ^ 4 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2) *
        ((1 + L N - L b) - delta N *
          ((1 + L N - L b) ^ 2 + M N - M b)))
proof:
:= by
  have hf := F_summand_two_blocks (b := b) hN
  have hl := ModY.sub (ModY.refl (2 * N) 1) (L_two_blocks_precise (b := b) hN)
  have hmul := ModY.mul hf hl
  refine ModY.trans hmul ?_
  refine ⟨A N ^ 4 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2) *
    (1 + L N - L b) * (M N - M b), ?_⟩
  have hpow : Y ^ (2 * N) = (Y ^ N) ^ 2 := by
    rw [pow_two, ← pow_add]
    congr 1
    omega
  rw [delta, hpow]
  ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.sum_W_first_precise_target
statement:
private theorem sum_W_first_precise_target (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
      A N ^ 2 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2) *
        ((1 - L N - L b) + delta N *
          ((1 - L b) * (1 - L N - L b) - M b))) =
      A N ^ 2 * (W N - L N * F N) +
        delta N * A N ^ 2 * (H N - L N * W N)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [show ∀ b : ℕ,
      A N ^ 2 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2) *
          ((1 - L N - L b) + delta N *
            ((1 - L b) * (1 - L N - L b) - M b)) =
        A N ^ 2 *
          (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2 * (1 - L b) -
            L N * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)) +
        (delta N * A N ^ 2) *
          (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2 * ((1 - L b) ^ 2 - M b) -
            L N * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2 * (1 - L b))) by
      intro b
      ring]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    ← Finset.mul_sum]
  rfl

name: IwasawaTower.Series.sum_W_second_precise_target
statement:
private theorem sum_W_second_precise_target (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
      A N ^ 4 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2) *
        ((1 + L N - L b) - delta N *
          ((1 + L N - L b) ^ 2 + M N - M b))) =
      A N ^ 4 * (W N + L N * F N) +
        delta N * A N ^ 4 *
          (-H N + L N * W N - (L N ^ 2 + M N) * F N)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [show ∀ b : ℕ,
      A N ^ 4 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2) *
          ((1 + L N - L b) - delta N *
            ((1 + L N - L b) ^ 2 + M N - M b)) =
        A N ^ 4 *
          (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2 * (1 - L b) +
            L N * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)) +
        (delta N * A N ^ 4) *
          (-(X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2 * ((1 - L b) ^ 2 - M b)) +
            L N * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2 * (1 - L b)) -
            (L N ^ 2 + M N) * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)) by
      intro b
      have hthree : (3 : PS) = 0 := CharP.cast_eq_zero (R := PS) 3
      linear_combination hthree *
        (A N ^ 4 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2) * delta N * L N * (L b - 1))]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum,
    ← Finset.mul_sum]
  rfl

name: IwasawaTower.Series.W_three_block_precise
statement:
theorem W_three_block_precise {N : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY (2 * N) (W (3 * N))
      (W N * (1 + A N ^ 2 + A N ^ 4) +
        L N * F N * (A N ^ 4 - A N ^ 2) +
        delta N *
          ((A N ^ 2 - A N ^ 4) * (H N - L N * W N) -
            A N ^ 4 * (L N ^ 2 + M N) * F N))
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst : ModY (2 * N)
      (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
        X ^ (N + b + 1) * A (N + b) ^ 2 * (1 - L (N + b)))
      (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
        A N ^ 2 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2) *
          ((1 - L N - L b) + delta N *
            ((1 - L b) * (1 - L N - L b) - M b))) :=
    ModY.sum _ fun b hb ↦ W_summand_one_block_precise hN
  have hsecond : ModY (2 * N)
      (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
        X ^ (2 * N + b + 1) * A (2 * N + b) ^ 2 * (1 - L (2 * N + b)))
      (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
        A N ^ 4 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2) *
          ((1 + L N - L b) - delta N *
            ((1 + L N - L b) ^ 2 + M N - M b))) :=
    ModY.sum _ fun b hb ↦ W_summand_two_blocks_precise hN
  rw [W_three_split]
  have hall := ModY.add (ModY.add (ModY.refl (2 * N) (W N)) hfirst) hsecond
  rw [sum_W_first_precise_target, sum_W_second_precise_target] at hall
  refine ModY.trans hall ?_
  exact ⟨0, by ring⟩

name: IwasawaTower.Series.W_three_block_coarse
statement:
theorem W_three_block_coarse {N : ℕ} (hN : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a) :
    ModY N (W (3 * N))
      (W N * (1 + A N ^ 2 + A N ^ 4) -
        L N * F N * (A N ^ 2 - A N ^ 4))
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst : ModY N
      (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
        X ^ (N + b + 1) * A (N + b) ^ 2 * (1 - L (N + b)))
      (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
        (A N ^ 2 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)) * (1 - (L N + L b))) :=
    ModY.sum _ fun b hb ↦ ModY.mul
      (F_summand_one_block_coarse hN)
      (ModY.sub (ModY.refl N 1) (L_one_block hN))
  have hsecond : ModY N
      (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
        X ^ (2 * N + b + 1) * A (2 * N + b) ^ 2 * (1 - L (2 * N + b)))
      (∑ b ∈ Finset.range N,
        (A N ^ 4 * (X ^ (b + 1) * A b ^ 2)) * (1 - (-L N + L b))) :=
    ModY.sum _ fun b hb ↦ ModY.mul
      (F_summand_two_blocks_coarse hN)
      (ModY.sub (ModY.refl N 1) (L_two_blocks hN))
  rw [W_three_split]
  have hall := ModY.add (ModY.add (ModY.refl N (W N)) hfirst) hsecond
  rw [sum_W_first_target, sum_W_second_target] at hall
  refine ModY.trans hall ?_
  exact ⟨0, by ring⟩

name: IwasawaTower.Series.InitialPolynomial.cast_mod_three
statement:
private theorem cast_mod_three (k : ℕ) :
    ((k : ℕ) : P) = Polynomial.C ((k % 3 : ℕ) : 𝔽₃)
proof:
:= by
  rw [CharP.cast_eq_mod (R := P) 3]
  rfl

name: IwasawaTower.Series.InitialPolynomial.C_two_eq_neg_one
statement: private theorem C_two_eq_neg_one : Polynomial.C (2 : 𝔽₃) = (-1 : P)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using congrArg (Polynomial.C : 𝔽₃ →+* P) (show (2 : 𝔽₃) = -1 by decide)

name: IwasawaTower.Series.InitialPolynomial.coe_f
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_f (N : ℕ) : ((f N : P) : PS) = F N
proof:
:= by
  simp [f, F]

name: IwasawaTower.Series.InitialPolynomial.f_three_exact
statement:
private theorem f_three_exact :
    f 3 = -FinitePolynomial.y + FinitePolynomial.y ^ 2 * qFThree
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [f, FinitePolynomial.a, FinitePolynomial.x, FinitePolynomial.y,
    qFThree, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.prod_range_succ]
  ring_nf
  simp only [← Nat.cast_ofNat (R := P), cast_mod_three]
  norm_num
  rw [C_two_eq_neg_one]
  ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.InitialPolynomial.a_three_sq_exact
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [FinitePolynomial.a, FinitePolynomial.x, FinitePolynomial.y,
    qAThree, Finset.prod_range_succ]
  ring_nf
  simp only [← Nat.cast_ofNat (R := P), cast_mod_three]
  norm_num
  rw [C_two_eq_neg_one]
  ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.F_three_hasLeading
statement: theorem F_three_hasLeading : HasLeading 1 (-1) (F 3)
proof:
:= by
  rw [HasLeading, ← InitialPolynomial.coe_f, InitialPolynomial.f_three_exact]
  refine ⟨((InitialPolynomial.qFThree : InitialPolynomial.P) : PS), ?_⟩
  simp [InitialPolynomial.qFThree, FinitePolynomial.y, Y]

name: IwasawaTower.Series.A_three_sq_sub_one_hasLeading
statement: theorem A_three_sq_sub_one_hasLeading : HasLeading 2 (-1) (A 3 ^ 2 - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hcoe : A 3 ^ 2 - 1 =
      (((FinitePolynomial.a 3 ^ 2 - 1 : InitialPolynomial.P) : PS)) := by simp
  rw [HasLeading, hcoe, InitialPolynomial.a_three_sq_exact]
  refine ⟨((InitialPolynomial.qAThree : InitialPolynomial.P) : PS), ?_⟩
  simp [InitialPolynomial.qAThree, FinitePolynomial.y, Y]

name: IwasawaTower.Series.HasLeading.vanishes
statement:
theorem HasLeading.vanishes {n : ℕ} {c : 𝔽₃} {f : PS}
    (h : HasLeading n c f) : Vanishes n f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h
  refine ⟨PowerSeries.C c + Y * q, ?_⟩
  rw [eq_add_of_sub_eq hq, pow_succ]
  ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.hasLeading_mul
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hg
  have hf' : f = PowerSeries.C c * Y ^ m + Y ^ (m + 1) * q := by
    rw [eq_add_of_sub_eq hq]
    ring
  have hg' : g = PowerSeries.C d * Y ^ n + Y ^ (n + 1) * r := by
    rw [eq_add_of_sub_eq hr]
    ring
  refine ⟨PowerSeries.C c * r + PowerSeries.C d * q + Y * q * r, ?_⟩
  rw [hf', hg']
  simp only [map_mul]
  rw [show m + n + 1 = m + (n + 1) by omega]
  simp only [pow_add]
  ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.hasLeading_pow
proof:
| 0 => by simp [HasLeading, ModY.refl]
  | k + 1 => by
      simpa [pow_succ, Nat.succ_mul, add_comm] using hasLeading_mul (hasLeading_pow h k) h

name: IwasawaTower.Series.L_one_sub_cube_vanishes
statement: private theorem L_one_sub_cube_vanishes : Vanishes 1 (L 1 - L 1 ^ 3)
proof:
:= by
  have hinv : (2 : 𝔽₃)⁻¹ = 2 :=
    ZMod.inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one 3 2 2 (by decide)
  have hc : constantCoeff (L 1 - L 1 ^ 3) = 0 := by
    simp [L, hinv]
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := PowerSeries.X_dvd_iff.mpr hc
  exact ⟨q, by simpa [Y] using hq⟩

name: IwasawaTower.Series.L_three_vanishes
statement: theorem L_three_vanishes : Vanishes 3 (L 3)
proof:
:= by
  have hrec := L_three_block_precise (N := 1) ⟨0, by norm_num⟩
  have hdelta : Vanishes 2 (delta 1 ^ 2) := by
    simpa [pow_two] using Vanishes.mul (delta_vanishes 1) (delta_vanishes 1)
  have hrhs : Vanishes 3 (delta 1 ^ 2 * (L 1 - L 1 ^ 3)) := by
    simpa using Vanishes.mul hdelta L_one_sub_cube_vanishes
  exact Vanishes.of_modY_zero (ModY.trans hrec (Vanishes.modY_zero hrhs))

name: IwasawaTower.Series.Vanishes.pow
statement:
theorem Vanishes.pow {n : ℕ} {f : PS} (h : Vanishes n f) : ∀ k : ℕ,
    Vanishes (k * n) (f ^ k)
proof:
| 0 => by simp [Vanishes.one_zero]
  | k + 1 => by
      simpa [pow_succ, Nat.succ_mul, add_comm] using Vanishes.mul (Vanishes.pow h k) h

name: IwasawaTower.Series.HasLeading.of_modY
statement:
theorem HasLeading.of_modY {n : ℕ} {c : 𝔽₃} {f g : PS}
    (hfg : ModY (n + 1) f g) (hg : HasLeading n c g) : HasLeading n c f
proof:
:=
  ModY.trans hfg hg

name: IwasawaTower.Series.one_add_sq_eq_sq_sub_one
statement:
private theorem one_add_sq_eq_sq_sub_one (B : PS) :
    1 + B + B ^ 2 = (B - 1) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hthree : (3 : PS) = 0 := CharP.cast_eq_zero (R := PS) 3
  linear_combination hthree * B

name: IwasawaTower.Series.cube_sq_sub_one
statement:
private theorem cube_sq_sub_one (a : PS) :
    (a ^ 3) ^ 2 - 1 = (a ^ 2 - 1) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hthree : (3 : PS) = 0 := CharP.cast_eq_zero (R := PS) 3
  linear_combination hthree * (a ^ 4 - a ^ 2)

name: IwasawaTower.Series.tower_step
statement: private theorem tower_step (b : ℕ) (ih : TowerData b) : TowerData (b + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let p := 3 ^ b
  let N := 3 ^ (b + 1)
  have hNp : N = 3 * p := by simp [N, p, pow_succ, mul_comm]
  have hNpos : 0 < N := by simp [N]
  have hNdiv : 3 ∣ N := by rw [hNp]; exact dvd_mul_right 3 p
  have hNpow : ∃ a, N = 3 ^ a := ⟨b + 1, rfl⟩
  let D := A N ^ 2 - 1
  have hDlead : HasLeading (2 * p) (-1) D := by
    simpa [D, N, p] using ih.aLead
  have hDvan : Vanishes (2 * p) D := hDlead.vanishes

  have hArec := A_three_block_cube hNpos hNdiv hNpow
  have hArecSq := ModY.pow hArec 2
  have hDrec : ModY (2 * N + 1) (A (3 * N) ^ 2 - 1) (D ^ 3) := by
    have hsub := ModY.sub hArecSq (ModY.refl (2 * N + 1) 1)
    simpa [D, cube_sq_sub_one] using hsub
  have hDcube₀ := hasLeading_pow hDlead 3
  have hDcube : HasLeading (2 * N) (-1) (D ^ 3) := by
    convert hDcube₀ using 1
    · rw [hNp]
      omega
    · decide
  have hAnext : HasLeading (2 * N) (-1) (A (3 * N) ^ 2 - 1) :=
    hDcube.of_modY hDrec

  have hLcube : Vanishes (3 * N) (L N ^ 3) := by
    simpa using ih.lVanish.pow 3
  have hLdiff : Vanishes N (L N - L N ^ 3) :=
    Vanishes.sub ih.lVanish (Vanishes.mono (by omega) hLcube)
  have hdeltaSq : Vanishes (2 * N) (delta N ^ 2) := by
    rw [pow_two]
    convert Vanishes.mul (delta_vanishes N) (delta_vanishes N) using 1 <;> omega
  have hLrhs : Vanishes (3 * N) (delta N ^ 2 * (L N - L N ^ 3)) := by
    convert Vanishes.mul hdeltaSq hLdiff using 1 <;> omega
  have hLnext : Vanishes (3 * N) (L (3 * N)) := by
    exact Vanishes.of_modY_zero
      (ModY.trans (L_three_block_precise hNpow) (Vanishes.modY_zero hLrhs))

  have hS : 1 + A N ^ 2 + A N ^ 4 = D ^ 2 := by
    have hthree : (3 : PS) = 0 := CharP.cast_eq_zero (R := PS) 3
    dsimp [D]
    linear_combination hthree * A N ^ 2
  have hDsqVan : Vanishes (4 * p) (D ^ 2) := by
    have := hDvan.pow 2
    convert this using 1 <;> omega
  have hWmain : Vanishes N (W N * (1 + A N ^ 2 + A N ^ 4)) := by
    rw [hS]
    have hprod := Vanishes.mul ih.wVanish hDsqVan
    exact Vanishes.mono (by rw [hNp]; omega) hprod
  have hWlog : Vanishes N (L N * F N * (A N ^ 2 - A N ^ 4)) :=
    by simpa [N, mul_assoc] using
      Vanishes.mul_right (F N * (A N ^ 2 - A N ^ 4)) ih.lVanish
  have hWrhs : Vanishes N
      (W N * (1 + A N ^ 2 + A N ^ 4) -
        L N * F N * (A N ^ 2 - A N ^ 4)) :=
    Vanishes.sub hWmain hWlog
  have hWnext : Vanishes N (W (3 * N)) :=
    Vanishes.of_modY_zero
      (ModY.trans (W_three_block_coarse hNpow) (Vanishes.modY_zero hWrhs))

  have hDsqLead₀ := hasLeading_pow hDlead 2
  have hFmain₀ := hasLeading_mul ih.fLead hDsqLead₀
  have hFmain : HasLeading (2 * N - 1) (-1) (F N * D ^ 2) := by
    convert hFmain₀ using 1
    · rw [hNp]
      omega
    · decide
  have honeSub : Vanishes (2 * p) (1 - A N ^ 2) := by
    simpa [D] using Vanishes.neg hDvan
  have hinnerOne : Vanishes (3 * p)
      (A N ^ 2 * (1 - A N ^ 2) * W N) := by
    have hprod₀ := Vanishes.mul honeSub ih.wVanish
    have hprod : Vanishes (3 * p) ((1 - A N ^ 2) * W N) := by
      convert hprod₀ using 1
      simp [p]
      omega
    simpa [mul_assoc] using Vanishes.mul_left (A N ^ 2) hprod
  have hcorrOne : Vanishes (2 * N)
      (delta N * (A N ^ 2 * (1 - A N ^ 2) * W N)) := by
    have hprod := Vanishes.mul (delta_vanishes N) hinnerOne
    convert hprod using 1
    rw [hNp]
    omega
  have hcorrTwoInner : Vanishes N (A N ^ 4 * L N * F N) := by
    have hprod := Vanishes.mul_left (A N ^ 4 * F N) ih.lVanish
    convert hprod using 1
    ring
  have hcorrTwo : Vanishes (2 * N) (delta N * (A N ^ 4 * L N * F N)) := by
    convert Vanishes.mul (delta_vanishes N) hcorrTwoInner using 1 <;> omega
  have hcorr : Vanishes (2 * N)
      (delta N *
        (A N ^ 2 * (1 - A N ^ 2) * W N - A N ^ 4 * L N * F N)) := by
    rw [mul_sub]
    exact Vanishes.sub hcorrOne hcorrTwo
  have hFdrop : ModY (2 * N)
      (F N * (1 + A N ^ 2 + A N ^ 4) +
        delta N *
          (A N ^ 2 * (1 - A N ^ 2) * W N - A N ^ 4 * L N * F N))
      (F N * D ^ 2) := by
    rw [hS]
    simpa using ModY.add (ModY.refl (2 * N) (F N * D ^ 2))
      (Vanishes.modY_zero hcorr)
  have hFrec := F_three_block_precise hNpow
  have hFmainMod : ModY (2 * N) (F N * D ^ 2)
      (PowerSeries.C (-1) * Y ^ (2 * N - 1)) := by
    simpa only [HasLeading, show 2 * N - 1 + 1 = 2 * N by omega] using hFmain
  have hFchain := ModY.trans hFrec (ModY.trans hFdrop hFmainMod)
  have hFnext : HasLeading (2 * N - 1) (-1) (F (3 * N)) := by
    simpa only [HasLeading, show 2 * N - 1 + 1 = 2 * N by omega] using hFchain

  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [N, pow_succ, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hFnext
  · simpa [N, pow_succ, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hAnext
  · simpa [N, pow_succ, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hLnext
  · simpa [N, pow_succ, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hWnext

name: IwasawaTower.Series.tower_data
statement: theorem tower_data (b : ℕ) : TowerData b
proof:
:= by
  induction b with
  | zero =>
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa using F_three_hasLeading
      · simpa using A_three_sq_sub_one_hasLeading
      · simpa using L_three_vanishes
      · exact Vanishes.mono (by omega) W_three_hasLeading.vanishes
  | succ b ih => simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using tower_step b ih

name: IwasawaTower.Series.F_three_power_hasLeading
statement:
theorem F_three_power_hasLeading (a : ℕ) :
    HasLeading (2 * 3 ^ a - 1) (-1) (F (3 ^ (a + 1)))
proof:
:=
  (tower_data a).fLead

name: IwasawaTower.Series.W_three_power_weak
statement:
theorem W_three_power_weak (a : ℕ) :
    Vanishes (3 ^ a) (W (3 ^ (a + 1)))
proof:
:=
  (tower_data a).wVanish

name: IwasawaTower.Series.delta_sq_hasLeading
statement:
private theorem delta_sq_hasLeading (N : ℕ) :
    HasLeading (2 * N) 1 (delta N ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : delta N ^ 2 = Y ^ (2 * N) := by
    rw [delta, neg_sq, ← pow_mul]
    congr 1
    omega
  rw [hpow, HasLeading]
  simpa using ModY.refl (2 * N + 1) (Y ^ (2 * N))

name: IwasawaTower.Series.M_one_sub_one_vanishes
statement: private theorem M_one_sub_one_vanishes : Vanishes 1 (M 1 - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : constantCoeff (M 1 - 1) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, constantCoeff_M]
    norm_num
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := PowerSeries.X_dvd_iff.mpr hc
  exact ⟨q, by simpa [Y] using hq⟩

name: IwasawaTower.Series.M_three_hasLeading
statement: theorem M_three_hasLeading : HasLeading 2 1 (M 3)
proof:
:= by
  have hrec := M_three_block_precise (N := 1) ⟨0, by norm_num⟩
  have hrhs : HasLeading 2 1 (delta 1 ^ 2 * M 1) := by
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := M_one_sub_one_vanishes
    refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
    rw [delta]
    simp only [map_one, one_mul, neg_sq]
    have hm1 : M 1 = 1 + Y * q := by
      rw [eq_add_of_sub_eq hq]
      ring
    rw [hm1]
    ring
  exact HasLeading.of_modY hrec hrhs

name: IwasawaTower.Series.M_three_power_hasLeading
statement:
theorem M_three_power_hasLeading (a : ℕ) :
    HasLeading (3 ^ (a + 1) - 1) 1 (M (3 ^ (a + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  induction a with
  | zero => simpa using M_three_hasLeading
  | succ a ih =>
      let N := 3 ^ (a + 1)
      have hNpow : ∃ b, N = 3 ^ b := ⟨a + 1, rfl⟩
      have hrec := M_three_block_precise hNpow
      have ihN : HasLeading (N - 1) 1 (M N) := by
        simpa [N] using ih
      have hprod₀ := hasLeading_mul (delta_sq_hasLeading N) ihN
      have hprod : HasLeading (3 * N - 1) 1 (delta N ^ 2 * M N) := by
        have hNpos : 0 < N := by positivity
        have hexp : 2 * N + (N - 1) = 3 * N - 1 := by omega
        simpa only [hexp, one_mul] using hprod₀
      have hmod : ModY (3 * N - 1 + 1) (M (3 * N))
          (delta N ^ 2 * M N) := by
        have hNpos : 0 < N := by positivity
        simpa only [show 3 * N - 1 + 1 = 3 * N by omega] using hrec
      have hnext := HasLeading.of_modY hmod hprod
      simpa [N, pow_succ, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hnext

name: IwasawaTower.Series.one_add_A_sq_A_fourth
statement:
private theorem one_add_A_sq_A_fourth (N : ℕ) :
    1 + A N ^ 2 + A N ^ 4 = (A N ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hthree : (3 : PS) = 0 := CharP.cast_eq_zero (R := PS) 3
  linear_combination hthree * A N ^ 2

name: IwasawaTower.Series.A_fourth_sub_sq
statement:
private theorem A_fourth_sub_sq (N : ℕ) :
    A N ^ 4 - A N ^ 2 = A N ^ 2 * (A N ^ 2 - 1)
proof: := by ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.A_sq_sub_fourth
statement:
private theorem A_sq_sub_fourth (N : ℕ) :
    A N ^ 2 - A N ^ 4 = -(A N ^ 2 * (A N ^ 2 - 1))
proof: := by ring

name: IwasawaTower.Series.H_nine_vanishes
statement: theorem H_nine_vanishes : Vanishes 3 (H 9)
proof:
:= by
  let D := A 3 ^ 2 - 1
  have hD : Vanishes 2 D := by
    simpa [D] using A_three_sq_sub_one_hasLeading.vanishes
  have hDsq : Vanishes 4 (D ^ 2) := by
    have h := hD.pow 2
    convert h using 1 <;> omega
  have hHmain : Vanishes 3 (H 3 * (1 + A 3 ^ 2 + A 3 ^ 4)) := by
    rw [one_add_A_sq_A_fourth]
    exact Vanishes.mono (by omega) (Vanishes.mul_left (H 3) hDsq)
  have hHlog : Vanishes 3 (L 3 * W 3 * (A 3 ^ 2 - A 3 ^ 4)) := by
    simpa [mul_assoc] using
      Vanishes.mul_right (W 3 * (A 3 ^ 2 - A 3 ^ 4)) L_three_vanishes
  have hLsq : Vanishes 6 (L 3 ^ 2) := by
    have h := L_three_vanishes.pow 2
    convert h using 1 <;> omega
  have hInnerL : Vanishes 2 (L 3 ^ 2 * (A 3 ^ 2 + A 3 ^ 4)) :=
    Vanishes.mono (by omega)
      (Vanishes.mul_right (A 3 ^ 2 + A 3 ^ 4) hLsq)
  have hInnerM : Vanishes 2 (M 3 * (A 3 ^ 4 - A 3 ^ 2)) := by
    rw [A_fourth_sub_sq]
    convert Vanishes.mul_left (M 3 * A 3 ^ 2) hD using 1 <;> ring
  have hInner : Vanishes 2
      (A 3 ^ 2 * (L 3 ^ 2 - M 3) + A 3 ^ 4 * (L 3 ^ 2 + M 3)) := by
    have hsum := Vanishes.add hInnerL hInnerM
    convert hsum using 1 <;> ring
  have hF : Vanishes 1 (F 3) := F_three_hasLeading.vanishes
  have hHthird : Vanishes 3
      (F 3 * (A 3 ^ 2 * (L 3 ^ 2 - M 3) +
        A 3 ^ 4 * (L 3 ^ 2 + M 3))) := by
    convert Vanishes.mul hF hInner using 1 <;> omega
  have hrhs : Vanishes 3
      (H 3 * (1 + A 3 ^ 2 + A 3 ^ 4) +
        L 3 * W 3 * (A 3 ^ 2 - A 3 ^ 4) +
        F 3 * (A 3 ^ 2 * (L 3 ^ 2 - M 3) +
          A 3 ^ 4 * (L 3 ^ 2 + M 3))) :=
    Vanishes.add (Vanishes.add hHmain hHlog) hHthird
  exact Vanishes.of_modY_zero
    (ModY.trans (H_three_block_coarse (N := 3) ⟨1, rfl⟩)
      (Vanishes.modY_zero hrhs))

name: IwasawaTower.Series.strong_step
statement: private theorem strong_step (b : ℕ) (ih : StrongData b) : StrongData (b + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let p := 3 ^ (b + 1)
  let N := 3 ^ (b + 2)
  have hNp : N = 3 * p := by simp [N, p, pow_succ, mul_comm]
  have hNpow : ∃ c, N = 3 ^ c := ⟨b + 2, rfl⟩
  have hNpos : 0 < N := by positivity
  let D := A N ^ 2 - 1
  have hbase := tower_data (b + 1)
  have hDlead : HasLeading (2 * p) (-1) D := by
    simpa [D, N, p] using hbase.aLead
  have hD : Vanishes (2 * p) D := hDlead.vanishes
  have hFlead : HasLeading (2 * p - 1) (-1) (F N) := by
    simpa [N, p] using hbase.fLead
  have hF : Vanishes (2 * p - 1) (F N) := hFlead.vanishes
  have hL : Vanishes N (L N) := by simpa [N] using hbase.lVanish
  have hW : Vanishes (2 * p - 1) (W N) := ih.wLead.vanishes
  have hM : Vanishes (N - 1) (M N) := ih.mLead.vanishes
  have hH : Vanishes p (H N) := by simpa [p, N] using ih.hVanish

  have hDsq : Vanishes (4 * p) (D ^ 2) := by
    have h := hD.pow 2
    convert h using 1 <;> omega

  
  have hHmain : Vanishes N (H N * (1 + A N ^ 2 + A N ^ 4)) := by
    rw [one_add_A_sq_A_fourth]
    have h := Vanishes.mul hH hDsq
    exact Vanishes.mono (by rw [hNp]; omega) h
  have hHlog : Vanishes N (L N * W N * (A N ^ 2 - A N ^ 4)) := by
    simpa [mul_assoc] using
      Vanishes.mul_right (W N * (A N ^ 2 - A N ^ 4)) hL
  have hLsq : Vanishes (2 * N) (L N ^ 2) := by
    have h := hL.pow 2
    convert h using 1 <;> omega
  have hInnerL : Vanishes N (L N ^ 2 * (A N ^ 2 + A N ^ 4)) :=
    Vanishes.mono (by omega)
      (Vanishes.mul_right (A N ^ 2 + A N ^ 4) hLsq)
  have hInnerM : Vanishes (N - 1 + 2 * p)
      (M N * (A N ^ 4 - A N ^ 2)) := by
    rw [A_fourth_sub_sq]
    have h := Vanishes.mul hM hD
    convert Vanishes.mul_left (A N ^ 2) h using 1 <;> ring
  have hInnerM' : Vanishes (N - (2 * p - 1))
      (M N * (A N ^ 4 - A N ^ 2)) := by
    apply Vanishes.mono _ hInnerM
    rw [hNp]
    omega
  have hInner : Vanishes (N - (2 * p - 1))
      (A N ^ 2 * (L N ^ 2 - M N) + A N ^ 4 * (L N ^ 2 + M N)) := by
    have hL' : Vanishes (N - (2 * p - 1))
        (L N ^ 2 * (A N ^ 2 + A N ^ 4)) :=
      Vanishes.mono (by omega) hInnerL
    have hsum := Vanishes.add hL' hInnerM'
    convert hsum using 1 <;> ring
  have hHthird : Vanishes N
      (F N * (A N ^ 2 * (L N ^ 2 - M N) +
        A N ^ 4 * (L N ^ 2 + M N))) := by
    have h := Vanishes.mul hF hInner
    convert h using 1
    rw [hNp]
    omega
  have hHrhs : Vanishes N
      (H N * (1 + A N ^ 2 + A N ^ 4) +
        L N * W N * (A N ^ 2 - A N ^ 4) +
        F N * (A N ^ 2 * (L N ^ 2 - M N) +
          A N ^ 4 * (L N ^ 2 + M N))) :=
    Vanishes.add (Vanishes.add hHmain hHlog) hHthird
  have hHnext : Vanishes N (H (3 * N)) :=
    Vanishes.of_modY_zero
      (ModY.trans (H_three_block_coarse hNpow) (Vanishes.modY_zero hHrhs))

  
  have ihWLead : HasLeading (2 * p - 1) 1 (W N) := by
    simpa [N, p] using ih.wLead
  have hDsqLead₀ := hasLeading_pow hDlead 2
  have hWmain₀ := hasLeading_mul ihWLead hDsqLead₀
  have hWmain : HasLeading (2 * N - 1) 1 (W N * D ^ 2) := by
    convert hWmain₀ using 1
    · rw [hNp]
      omega
    · decide
  have hWfactor : 1 + A N ^ 2 + A N ^ 4 = D ^ 2 := by
    simpa [D] using one_add_A_sq_A_fourth N

  
  have hAdiffFourth : Vanishes (2 * p) (A N ^ 4 - A N ^ 2) := by
    rw [A_fourth_sub_sq]
    simpa [mul_assoc] using Vanishes.mul_left (A N ^ 2) hD
  have hLogCorrection : Vanishes (2 * N)
      (L N * F N * (A N ^ 4 - A N ^ 2)) := by
    have hFA := Vanishes.mul hF hAdiffFourth
    have hAll := Vanishes.mul hL hFA
    apply Vanishes.mono _
    · simpa [mul_assoc] using hAll
    · rw [hNp]
      have hp : 0 < p := by positivity
      omega
  have hAdiff : Vanishes (2 * p) (A N ^ 2 - A N ^ 4) := by
    rw [A_sq_sub_fourth]
    simpa [mul_assoc] using Vanishes.mul_left (-A N ^ 2) hD
  have hLW : Vanishes p (L N * W N) := by
    exact Vanishes.mono (by rw [hNp]; omega) (Vanishes.mul hL hW)
  have hHminus : Vanishes p (H N - L N * W N) :=
    Vanishes.sub hH hLW
  have hFirstInner : Vanishes (3 * p)
      ((A N ^ 2 - A N ^ 4) * (H N - L N * W N)) := by
    convert Vanishes.mul hAdiff hHminus using 1 <;> omega
  have hLsqPlusM : Vanishes (N - 1) (L N ^ 2 + M N) := by
    exact Vanishes.add (Vanishes.mono (by omega) hLsq) hM
  have hSecondInner₀ : Vanishes (N - 1 + (2 * p - 1))
      ((L N ^ 2 + M N) * F N) :=
    Vanishes.mul hLsqPlusM hF
  have hSecondInner : Vanishes N
      (A N ^ 4 * (L N ^ 2 + M N) * F N) := by
    have hmono : Vanishes N ((L N ^ 2 + M N) * F N) := by
      apply Vanishes.mono _ hSecondInner₀
      rw [hNp]
      omega
    simpa [mul_assoc] using Vanishes.mul_left (A N ^ 4) hmono
  have hDeltaInner : Vanishes N
      ((A N ^ 2 - A N ^ 4) * (H N - L N * W N) -
        A N ^ 4 * (L N ^ 2 + M N) * F N) := by
    have hFirstN : Vanishes N
        ((A N ^ 2 - A N ^ 4) * (H N - L N * W N)) := by
      simpa [hNp] using hFirstInner
    exact Vanishes.sub hFirstN hSecondInner
  have hDeltaCorrection : Vanishes (2 * N)
      (delta N *
        ((A N ^ 2 - A N ^ 4) * (H N - L N * W N) -
          A N ^ 4 * (L N ^ 2 + M N) * F N)) := by
    convert Vanishes.mul (delta_vanishes N) hDeltaInner using 1 <;> omega
  have hCorrections : Vanishes (2 * N)
      (L N * F N * (A N ^ 4 - A N ^ 2) +
        delta N *
          ((A N ^ 2 - A N ^ 4) * (H N - L N * W N) -
            A N ^ 4 * (L N ^ 2 + M N) * F N)) :=
    Vanishes.add hLogCorrection hDeltaCorrection
  have hDrop : ModY (2 * N)
      (W N * (1 + A N ^ 2 + A N ^ 4) +
        L N * F N * (A N ^ 4 - A N ^ 2) +
        delta N *
          ((A N ^ 2 - A N ^ 4) * (H N - L N * W N) -
            A N ^ 4 * (L N ^ 2 + M N) * F N))
      (W N * D ^ 2) := by
    rw [hWfactor]
    simpa [add_assoc] using ModY.add (ModY.refl (2 * N) (W N * D ^ 2))
      (Vanishes.modY_zero hCorrections)
  have hWrec := W_three_block_precise hNpow
  have hWmainMod : ModY (2 * N) (W N * D ^ 2)
      (PowerSeries.C 1 * Y ^ (2 * N - 1)) := by
    simpa only [HasLeading, show 2 * N - 1 + 1 = 2 * N by omega] using hWmain
  have hWchain := ModY.trans hWrec (ModY.trans hDrop hWmainMod)
  have hWnext : HasLeading (2 * N - 1) 1 (W (3 * N)) := by
    simpa only [HasLeading, show 2 * N - 1 + 1 = 2 * N by omega] using hWchain

  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [N, pow_succ, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hWnext
  · simpa [N] using M_three_power_hasLeading (b + 2)
  · simpa [N, pow_succ, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hHnext

name: IwasawaTower.Series.strong_data
statement: theorem strong_data (b : ℕ) : StrongData b
proof:
:= by
  induction b with
  | zero =>
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa using W_nine_hasLeading
      · simpa using M_three_power_hasLeading 1
      · simpa using H_nine_vanishes
  | succ b ih => simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using strong_step b ih

name: IwasawaTower.Series.W_three_power_strong

proof:
:= by
  let b := a - 2
  have hab : b + 2 = a := by
    dsimp [b]
    omega
  simpa [hab, show b + 1 = a - 1 by dsimp [b]; omega] using
    (strong_data b).wLead

name: IwasawaTower.Series.FinitePolynomial.coe_sum
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_sum {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → P) :
    ((∑ i ∈ s, f i : P) : PS) = ∑ i ∈ s, ((f i : P) : PS)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi ih => simp [hi, ih, Polynomial.coe_add]

name: IwasawaTower.Series.FinitePolynomial.coe_prod
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_prod {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → P) :
    ((∏ i ∈ s, f i : P) : PS) = ∏ i ∈ s, ((f i : P) : PS)
proof:
:= by

  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi ih => simp [hi, ih, Polynomial.coe_mul]

name: IwasawaTower.Series.FinitePolynomial.prod_ite_one_eq_prod_erase
statement:
private theorem prod_ite_one_eq_prod_erase {ι M : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    [CommMonoid M] (s : Finset ι) (j : ι) (f : ι → M) :
    (∏ l ∈ s, if l = j then 1 else f l) = ∏ l ∈ s.erase j, f l
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst i
        rw [Finset.prod_insert hi, if_pos rfl, one_mul, ih,
          Finset.erase_insert hi, Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem hi]
      · rw [Finset.prod_insert hi, if_neg hij, ih,
          Finset.erase_insert_of_ne hij, Finset.prod_insert (by simp [hi])]

name: IwasawaTower.Series.modY_of_coe_trunc_eq

proof:
:= by

  rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add, ← h]
  simpa [Y] using PowerSeries.eq_X_pow_mul_shift_add_trunc n f

name: IwasawaTower.Series.trunc_W_three
statement:
private theorem trunc_W_three :
    (PowerSeries.trunc 3 (W 3) : PS) = Y ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [W_eq_WPolynomial, ← FinitePolynomial.coe_w, FinitePolynomial.w_three_exact]
  ext i
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_coe, PowerSeries.coeff_trunc]
  by_cases hi : i < 3
  · rw [if_pos hi]
    interval_cases i <;>
      norm_num [FinitePolynomial.y, Y, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow]
  · have hi2 : i ≠ 2 := by omega
    simp [hi, hi2, FinitePolynomial.y, Y, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow]

  · simp only [if_pos hi, Polynomial.coe_add, Polynomial.coe_pow, Polynomial.coe_X,

    rw [map_add, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul']
    have hn : ¬6 ≤ i := by omega

    simp [hi, hi5, FinitePolynomial.y, Y, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow]
