name: IwasawaTower.one_add_pow_ne_zero
statement:
theorem one_add_pow_ne_zero (hodd : Odd k) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ k) (j : ℕ) :
    1 + ζ ^ j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hj : ζ ^ j = -1 := by linear_combination h
  have hp := congrArg (fun z : K ↦ z ^ k) hj
  rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul, hζ.pow_eq_one, one_pow, hodd.neg_one_pow] at hp
  have hne : (1 : K) ≠ -1 := by norm_num
  exact hne hp

name: IwasawaTower.full_denominator_product
statement:
theorem full_denominator_product (hodd : Odd k) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ k) : pochhammer ζ (k - 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hk.ne'
  have hfactor := X_pow_sub_C_eq_prod hζ (Nat.succ_pos n)
    (hodd.neg_one_pow : (-1 : K) ^ (n + 1) = -1)
  have hev := congrArg (Polynomial.eval (1 : K)) hfactor
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X,
    Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_prod, one_pow, one_mul, mul_neg,
    sub_neg_eq_add] at hev
  rw [Finset.prod_range_succ'] at hev
  have htwo : (2 : K) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  have hprod : pochhammer ζ n * 2 = 2 := by
    simpa [pochhammer] using hev
  apply mul_right_cancel₀ htwo
  simpa using hprod

name: IwasawaTower.pochhammer_ne_zero
statement:
theorem pochhammer_ne_zero (hodd : Odd k) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ k)
    {r : ℕ} (_hr : r < k) : pochhammer ζ r ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro j hj
  exact one_add_pow_ne_zero hodd hζ (j + 1)

name: IwasawaTower.twice_triangular
statement:
private theorem twice_triangular (m : ℕ) :
    2 * (m * (m + 1) / 2) = m * (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.two_mul_div_two_of_even
  rcases m.even_or_odd with ⟨a, rfl⟩ | ⟨a, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨a * (2 * a + 1), by ring⟩
  · exact ⟨(2 * a + 1) * (a + 1), by ring⟩

name: IwasawaTower.sum_range_add_one
statement:
private theorem sum_range_add_one (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (j + 1) = m * (m + 1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (j + 1) = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, j) + m := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      simp
    _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), j := by
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
    _ = (m + 1) * m / 2 := Finset.sum_range_id (m + 1)
    _ = m * (m + 1) / 2 := by rw [mul_comm]

name: IwasawaTower.reflected_tail
statement:
private theorem reflected_tail (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ k) {r m : ℕ}
    (hkm : r + m + 1 = k) :
    (∏ j ∈ Finset.range m, (1 + ζ ^ (r + j + 1))) =
      (ζ⁻¹) ^ (m * (m + 1) / 2) * pochhammer ζ m
proof:
:= by
  have hζ0 : ζ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    subst ζ
    have := hζ.pow_eq_one
    simp [show k ≠ 0 by omega] at this
  rw [← Finset.prod_range_reflect]
  have hfactor (j : ℕ) (hj : j < m) :
      1 + ζ ^ (r + (m - 1 - j) + 1) =
        (ζ⁻¹) ^ (j + 1) * (1 + ζ ^ (j + 1)) := by
    have hjk : j + 1 ≤ k := by omega
    have hexp : r + (m - 1 - j) + 1 = k - (j + 1) := by omega
    rw [hexp]
    have hpow : ζ ^ (k - (j + 1)) = (ζ⁻¹) ^ (j + 1) := by
      have hmul : ζ ^ (k - (j + 1)) * ζ ^ (j + 1) = 1 := by
        rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hjk, hζ.pow_eq_one]
      simpa only [inv_pow] using eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left hmul
    rw [hpow]
    rw [mul_add, mul_one]
    have hinv : (ζ⁻¹) ^ (j + 1) * ζ ^ (j + 1) = 1 := by
      rw [← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hζ0, one_pow]
    rw [hinv, add_comm]
  simp_rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun j hj ↦ hfactor j (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)),
    Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  rw [Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, sum_range_add_one]
  rfl

name: IwasawaTower.denominator_reversal
statement:
theorem denominator_reversal (hodd : Odd k) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ k) {r : ℕ} (hr : r < k) :
    (pochhammer ζ r)⁻¹ =
      (ζ⁻¹) ^ ((k - r - 1) * (k - r) / 2) * pochhammer ζ (k - r - 1)
proof:
:= by
  let m := k - r - 1
  have hrm : r + m + 1 = k := by dsimp [m]; omega
  have hsplit : pochhammer ζ (k - 1) =
      pochhammer ζ r * ∏ j ∈ Finset.range m, (1 + ζ ^ (r + j + 1)) := by
    rw [show k - 1 = r + m by omega, pochhammer, Finset.prod_range_add]
    rfl
  have hfull := full_denominator_product hodd hk hζ
  rw [hsplit] at hfull
  calc
    (pochhammer ζ r)⁻¹ =
        (pochhammer ζ r)⁻¹ *
          (pochhammer ζ r * ∏ j ∈ Finset.range m, (1 + ζ ^ (r + j + 1))) := by
            rw [hfull, mul_one]
    _ = ∏ j ∈ Finset.range m, (1 + ζ ^ (r + j + 1)) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (pochhammer_ne_zero hodd hζ hr), one_mul]
    _ = (ζ⁻¹) ^ (m * (m + 1) / 2) * pochhammer ζ m :=
      reflected_tail hζ hrm
    _ = (ζ⁻¹) ^ ((k - r - 1) * (k - r) / 2) *
        pochhammer ζ (k - r - 1) := by
      have hm : m = k - r - 1 := rfl
      have hm1 : m + 1 = k - r := by omega
      rw [hm, hm1]

name: IwasawaTower.reversed_summand
statement:
private theorem reversed_summand (hodd : Odd k) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ k) {r : ℕ} (hr : r < k) :
    ζ ^ (r * r) / pochhammer ζ r ^ 2 =
      ζ ^ (k - r - 1 + 1) * pochhammer ζ (k - r - 1) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let m := k - r - 1
  let t := m * (m + 1) / 2
  have hrm : r + m + 1 = k := by dsimp [m]; omega
  have hζ0 : ζ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    subst ζ
    simpa [show k ≠ 0 by omega] using hζ.pow_eq_one
  have hexp : m + 1 + 2 * t = (m + 1) ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [t]
    rw [twice_triangular]
    ring
  have hmod : r * r ≡ m + 1 + 2 * t [MOD k] := by
    rw [hexp, ← ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff]
    push_cast
    have hrsum : (r : ZMod k) + (m + 1 : ℕ) = 0 := by
      rw [← Nat.cast_add, show r + (m + 1) = k by omega]
      simp
    have hrneg : (r : ZMod k) = -(m + 1 : ℕ) := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hrsum
    rw [hrneg]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hpow : ζ ^ (r * r) = ζ ^ (m + 1 + 2 * t) :=
    pow_eq_pow_of_modEq hmod hζ.pow_eq_one
  have hlead : ζ ^ (r * r) * (ζ⁻¹) ^ (2 * t) = ζ ^ (m + 1) := by
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero (2 * t) hζ0)
    rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hζ0, one_pow, mul_one,
      ← pow_add, hpow]
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← inv_pow, denominator_reversal hodd hk hζ hr]
  have hm : k - r - 1 = m := rfl
  have hm1 : k - r = m + 1 := by omega
  rw [hm, hm1]
  change ζ ^ (r * r) * (((ζ⁻¹) ^ t * pochhammer ζ m) ^ 2) = _
  rw [mul_pow]
  have ht : ((ζ⁻¹) ^ t) ^ 2 = (ζ⁻¹) ^ (2 * t) := by
    rw [← pow_mul]
    congr 1
    omega
  rw [ht]
  calc
    ζ ^ (r * r) * ((ζ⁻¹) ^ (2 * t) * pochhammer ζ m ^ 2) =
        (ζ ^ (r * r) * (ζ⁻¹) ^ (2 * t)) * pochhammer ζ m ^ 2 := by ring
    _ = ζ ^ (m + 1) * pochhammer ζ m ^ 2 := by rw [hlead]
    _ = ζ ^ (k - r - 1 + 1) * pochhammer ζ (k - r - 1) ^ 2 := by rfl

name: IwasawaTower.T_eq_F
statement:
theorem T_eq_F (hodd : Odd k) (hk : 0 < k) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ k) :
    T k ζ = F k ζ
proof:
:= by
  rw [T, F, ← Finset.sum_range_reflect
    (fun r ↦ ζ ^ (r + 1) * pochhammer ζ r ^ 2) k]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r hr
  have hrk := Finset.mem_range.mp hr
  rw [reversed_summand hodd hk hζ hrk]
  have hsub : k - r - 1 = k - 1 - r := by omega
  rw [hsub]
